ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Si ça ne vous dérange pas, nous préférerions une table un peu à l'écart, loin du brouhaha de la terrasse.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: If you don't mind, we'd rather have a table somewhat out of the way, far from the hubbub of the terrace.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Se não for incômodo, preferiríamos uma mesa um pouco mais reservada, longe do burburinho do terraço.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le serveur nous a conseillé le plat du jour, mais j'avoue que la carte des desserts me faisait davantage envie.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The waiter recommended the dish of the day, but I admit the dessert menu tempted me more.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O garçom nos recomendou o prato do dia, mas confesso que o cardápio de sobremesas me dava mais vontade.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Auriez-vous l'amabilité de nous indiquer quels plats peuvent être préparés sans gluten ni produits laitiers ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Would you be kind enough to tell us which dishes can be prepared without gluten or dairy?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Você teria a gentileza de nos indicar quais pratos podem ser preparados sem glúten nem laticínios?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Bien que le restaurant soit réputé, je trouve que l'addition était franchement salée pour ce qu'on a mangé.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Although the restaurant is well known, I find the bill was frankly steep for what we ate.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Embora o restaurante seja famoso, acho que a conta saiu bem salgada pelo que comemos.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je prendrai le magret de canard, à condition qu'il soit servi rosé et non trop cuit comme la dernière fois.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'll have the duck breast, provided it's served pink and not overcooked like last time.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vou querer o magret de pato, desde que venha rosado e não passado demais como da última vez.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Puisque c'est Julien qui a choisi l'adresse, c'est à lui de régler l'addition, ce me semble !
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Since Julien chose the place, it's up to him to pay the bill, it seems to me!
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Já que foi o Julien que escolheu o lugar, cabe a ele pagar a conta, me parece!

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous aurions aimé réserver pour huit personnes samedi soir, mais apparemment tout est complet jusqu'à la fin du mois.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We would have liked to book for eight people on Saturday evening, but apparently everything is full until the end of the month.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Gostaríamos de ter reservado para oito pessoas no sábado à noite, mas pelo visto está tudo lotado até o fim do mês.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le vin que vous nous avez suggéré se marie à merveille avec le fromage, je vous en félicite.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The wine you suggested pairs wonderfully with the cheese, my compliments.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O vinho que você nos sugeriu combina maravilhosamente com o queijo, meus parabéns.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Excusez-moi, mais il me semble qu'il y a une erreur sur l'addition, nous n'avons pris que deux cafés.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Excuse me, but I think there's a mistake on the bill, we only had two coffees.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Com licença, mas acho que há um erro na conta, só pedimos dois cafés.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Ce petit bistrot ne paie pas de mine, pourtant on y mange l'une des meilleures blanquettes de Lyon.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: This little bistro doesn't look like much, yet it serves one of the best blanquettes in Lyon.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Esse bistrozinho não chama a atenção, mas é ali que se come um dos melhores blanquettes de Lyon.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Vu l'attente interminable entre l'entrée et le plat, je doute fort que nous revenions un jour.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Given the endless wait between the starter and the main course, I strongly doubt we'll ever come back.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Considerando a espera interminável entre a entrada e o prato principal, duvido muito que voltemos um dia.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Pourriez-vous nous apporter une carafe d'eau et un peu plus de pain, s'il vous plaît ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Could you bring us a jug of water and a bit more bread, please?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Você poderia nos trazer uma jarra de água e um pouco mais de pão, por favor?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je me suis laissé tenter par la tarte Tatin, quitte à faire une entorse à mon régime.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I let myself be tempted by the tarte Tatin, even if it meant breaking my diet.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Me deixei tentar pela torta Tatin, mesmo que isso significasse furar a dieta.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le chef tient à ce que tous ses produits proviennent de fermes situées à moins de cinquante kilomètres.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The chef insists that all his produce come from farms located less than fifty kilometres away.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O chef faz questão de que todos os seus produtos venham de fazendas a menos de cinquenta quilômetros.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Est-ce que le service est compris, ou est-il d'usage de laisser un pourboire dans ce genre d'établissement ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Is service included, or is it customary to leave a tip in this kind of place?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O serviço está incluído ou é costume deixar gorjeta nesse tipo de estabelecimento?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Camille a renvoyé son plat en cuisine, ce qui, entre nous, n'était pas tout à fait justifié.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Camille sent her dish back to the kitchen, which, between us, wasn't entirely justified.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A Camille devolveu o prato para a cozinha, o que, cá entre nós, não era totalmente justificado.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Pour peu qu'on arrive avant midi, on devrait trouver une place en terrasse sans trop de difficulté.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: As long as we arrive before noon, we should find a seat on the terrace without too much trouble.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Contanto que a gente chegue antes do meio-dia, devemos achar um lugar no terraço sem muita dificuldade.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je vous recommande vivement le menu dégustation, même s'il faut prévoir au moins trois heures à table.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I highly recommend the tasting menu, even if you need to allow at least three hours at the table.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Recomendo muito o menu degustação, mesmo que seja preciso reservar pelo menos três horas à mesa.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous fêtons l'anniversaire de ma mère ce soir, serait-il possible de prévoir une bougie sur son dessert ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We're celebrating my mother's birthday tonight, would it be possible to put a candle on her dessert?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Estamos comemorando o aniversário da minha mãe hoje à noite, seria possível colocar uma vela na sobremesa dela?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Ce qui m'a le plus frappé, c'est la gentillesse du personnel, qui s'est montré aux petits soins.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: What struck me most was the kindness of the staff, who were extremely attentive.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O que mais me impressionou foi a gentileza dos funcionários, que nos trataram com todo o carinho.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Un café serré et un croissant, comme d'habitude, et mettez-moi aussi l'addition de mon collègue.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: A strong espresso and a croissant, as usual, and put my colleague's bill on mine too.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Um café curto e um croissant, como sempre, e coloque também a conta do meu colega na minha.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Il paraît que ce restaurant a décroché une étoile, ce qui explique sans doute la flambée des prix.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Apparently this restaurant got a star, which probably explains the soaring prices.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Parece que esse restaurante ganhou uma estrela, o que sem dúvida explica a disparada dos preços.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je ne suis pas un grand amateur de fruits de mer, mais ce plateau m'a fait changer d'avis.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'm not a big fan of seafood, but this platter changed my mind.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Não sou muito fã de frutos do mar, mas essa travessa me fez mudar de ideia.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Avez-vous une table de libre dans un coin calme, ou faut-il patienter au bar ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Do you have a free table in a quiet corner, or do we have to wait at the bar?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vocês têm uma mesa livre num canto tranquilo, ou temos que esperar no bar?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: On aurait dû se méfier quand on a vu que la salle était vide un vendredi soir.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We should have been wary when we saw the dining room was empty on a Friday night.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Devíamos ter desconfiado quando vimos que o salão estava vazio numa sexta à noite.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Si vous hésitez entre les deux vins, je vous conseillerais plutôt le bordeaux, plus rond en bouche.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: If you're torn between the two wines, I'd rather recommend the Bordeaux, which is rounder on the palate.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Se você está em dúvida entre os dois vinhos, eu recomendaria o bordeaux, mais redondo na boca.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le patron nous a offert le digestif, histoire de se faire pardonner le retard du service.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The owner offered us an after-dinner drink, as a way of making up for the slow service.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O dono nos ofereceu um digestivo, para se desculpar pela demora no atendimento.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Faut-il absolument réserver, ou est-ce que vous acceptez les clients sans réservation le dimanche midi ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Is a reservation absolutely necessary, or do you accept walk-ins on Sunday lunchtime?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: É obrigatório reservar, ou vocês aceitam clientes sem reserva no domingo na hora do almoço?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je n'ai pas fini mon assiette, non pas que ce soit mauvais, mais les portions sont gigantesques.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I didn't finish my plate, not that it was bad, but the portions are huge.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Não terminei meu prato, não que estivesse ruim, mas as porções são gigantescas.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Mathilde, qui est végétarienne, a eu du mal à trouver son bonheur sur une carte aussi carnée.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Mathilde, who's vegetarian, struggled to find something she liked on such a meat-heavy menu.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A Mathilde, que é vegetariana, teve dificuldade de achar algo de que gostasse num cardápio tão cheio de carne.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Nous voudrions partager plusieurs petites assiettes plutôt que de prendre chacun un plat principal, c'est possible ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We'd like to share several small plates rather than each having a main course, is that possible?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Gostaríamos de dividir vários pratinhos em vez de cada um pedir um prato principal, é possível?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: À en juger par la file d'attente devant la porte, cette crêperie doit valoir le détour.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Judging by the queue outside the door, this crêperie must be worth the detour.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A julgar pela fila na porta, essa creperia deve valer a visita.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Je regrette de devoir vous le dire, mais la soupe était tiède quand on nous l'a servie.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'm sorry to have to tell you, but the soup was lukewarm when it was served to us.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Lamento ter que dizer isso, mas a sopa estava morna quando nos serviram.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Monsieur, pourrions-nous avoir la même chose, mais cette fois avec les glaçons à part ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Excuse me, could we have the same again, but this time with the ice on the side?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Moço, poderíamos pedir a mesma coisa, mas desta vez com o gelo à parte?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le brunch du dimanche est devenu un rituel incontournable pour notre bande d'amis depuis des années.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Sunday brunch has been an unmissable ritual for our group of friends for years now.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O brunch de domingo virou um ritual obrigatório para a nossa turma de amigos há anos.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Une fois n'est pas coutume, c'est moi qui invite, alors commandez ce qui vous fait plaisir.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Just this once, it's my treat, so order whatever you like.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Uma vez na vida, eu que convido, então peçam o que quiserem.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Il a fallu attendre quarante minutes avant qu'on daigne enfin venir prendre notre commande.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We had to wait forty minutes before someone finally deigned to come and take our order.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Tivemos que esperar quarenta minutos até que alguém finalmente se dignasse a vir anotar nosso pedido.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Le cadre est magnifique, certes, mais la cuisine n'est pas à la hauteur de la réputation de la maison.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The setting is magnificent, granted, but the food doesn't live up to the restaurant's reputation.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O ambiente é magnífico, é verdade, mas a comida não está à altura da reputação da casa.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Vous pouvez me mettre le reste dans une boîte à emporter, s'il vous plaît, ce serait dommage de gaspiller.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Could you put the rest in a takeaway box for me, please, it would be a shame to waste it.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Você pode colocar o resto numa embalagem para viagem, por favor, seria uma pena desperdiçar.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Que diriez-vous de prendre le café ailleurs, dans un endroit un peu moins bruyant que celui-ci ?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: How about having coffee somewhere else, somewhere a little less noisy than this?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Que tal tomarmos o café em outro lugar, num lugar um pouco menos barulhento que este?

travel and directions.text: Si vous continuez tout droit jusqu'au rond-point, vous verrez la gare sur votre gauche, juste après la pharmacie.
travel and directions.en: If you keep going straight to the roundabout, you'll see the station on your left, just after the pharmacy.
travel and directions.pt: Se você seguir em frente até a rotatória, vai ver a estação à sua esquerda, logo depois da farmácia.

travel and directions.text: Notre vol ayant été annulé à la dernière minute, nous avons dû passer la nuit à l'aéroport de Francfort.
travel and directions.en: Our flight having been cancelled at the last minute, we had to spend the night at Frankfurt airport.
travel and directions.pt: Como nosso voo foi cancelado na última hora, tivemos que passar a noite no aeroporto de Frankfurt.

travel and directions.text: Auriez-vous l'obligeance de m'indiquer le chemin le plus court pour rejoindre le musée d'Orsay à pied ?
travel and directions.en: Would you kindly show me the shortest way to the Musée d'Orsay on foot?
travel and directions.pt: Você poderia, por gentileza, me indicar o caminho mais curto para chegar ao Museu d'Orsay a pé?

travel and directions.text: Je me suis complètement perdu dans les ruelles de la vieille ville, faute d'avoir téléchargé une carte hors ligne.
travel and directions.en: I got completely lost in the old town's alleys, having failed to download an offline map.
travel and directions.pt: Eu me perdi completamente nas vielas da cidade velha, por não ter baixado um mapa offline.

travel and directions.text: Plutôt que de louer une voiture, nous avons préféré sillonner la Bretagne en train et à vélo.
travel and directions.en: Rather than renting a car, we preferred to criss-cross Brittany by train and bike.
travel and directions.pt: Em vez de alugar um carro, preferimos percorrer a Bretanha de trem e de bicicleta.

travel and directions.text: Il vaut mieux éviter l'autoroute un vendredi soir de juillet, à moins d'aimer les bouchons interminables.
travel and directions.en: It's better to avoid the motorway on a Friday evening in July, unless you like endless traffic jams.
travel and directions.pt: É melhor evitar a rodovia numa sexta à noite de julho, a não ser que você goste de engarrafamentos intermináveis.

travel and directions.text: Le contrôleur m'a infligé une amende parce que j'avais oublié de composter mon billet avant de monter.
travel and directions.en: The inspector fined me because I'd forgotten to validate my ticket before boarding.
travel and directions.pt: O fiscal me multou porque eu tinha esquecido de validar a passagem antes de embarcar.

travel and directions.text: Une fois arrivés à Montpellier, il faudra encore compter une bonne heure de route pour atteindre notre gîte.
travel and directions.en: Once we arrive in Montpellier, we'll still need a good hour's drive to reach our holiday cottage.
travel and directions.pt: Quando chegarmos a Montpellier, ainda vamos precisar de uma boa hora de estrada para chegar à nossa casa de campo.

travel and directions.text: Savez-vous si cette ligne de bus dessert encore la plage, ou a-t-elle été modifiée pendant les travaux ?
travel and directions.en: Do you know if this bus line still goes to the beach, or was it changed during the roadworks?
travel and directions.pt: Você sabe se essa linha de ônibus ainda passa pela praia, ou ela foi alterada durante as obras?

travel and directions.text: Nous avons beau avoir vérifié trois fois l'itinéraire, le GPS nous a conduits dans un chemin de terre.
travel and directions.en: Even though we checked the route three times, the GPS led us down a dirt track.
travel and directions.pt: Por mais que tenhamos conferido o itinerário três vezes, o GPS nos levou para uma estrada de terra.

travel and directions.text: Le trajet Paris-Bordeaux ne prend plus que deux heures depuis la mise en service de la ligne à grande vitesse.
travel and directions.en: The trip between Paris and Bordeaux takes only two hours since the high-speed line opened.
travel and directions.pt: A viagem entre Paris e Bordeaux leva só duas horas desde a inauguração da linha de alta velocidade.

travel and directions.text: Excusez-moi de vous déranger, mais je cherche une rue qui ne figure apparemment sur aucun plan.
travel and directions.en: Sorry to bother you, but I'm looking for a street that apparently isn't on any map.
travel and directions.pt: Desculpe incomodar, mas estou procurando uma rua que aparentemente não aparece em nenhum mapa.

travel and directions.text: Si j'avais su que la valise serait égarée, j'aurais mis une tenue de rechange dans mon bagage à main.
travel and directions.en: If I'd known the suitcase would be lost, I'd have put a change of clothes in my hand luggage.
travel and directions.pt: Se eu soubesse que a mala seria extraviada, teria colocado uma muda de roupa na bagagem de mão.

travel and directions.text: Prenez la deuxième à droite après le feu, puis longez le canal jusqu'au pont en fer.
travel and directions.en: Take the second right after the traffic lights, then follow the canal to the iron bridge.
travel and directions.pt: Pegue a segunda à direita depois do semáforo e siga ao longo do canal até a ponte de ferro.

travel and directions.text: Lucie voyage toujours léger, quitte à racheter sur place ce qu'elle a oublié d'emporter.
travel and directions.en: Lucie always travels light, even if it means buying on the spot whatever she forgot to bring.
travel and directions.pt: A Lucie sempre viaja com pouca bagagem, mesmo que tenha que comprar no destino o que esqueceu de levar.

travel and directions.text: Est-il prudent de se promener seul dans ce quartier une fois la nuit tombée, à votre avis ?
travel and directions.en: In your opinion, is it safe to walk alone in this neighbourhood after dark?
travel and directions.pt: Na sua opinião, é seguro andar sozinho nesse bairro depois que anoitece?

travel and directions.text: La correspondance à Lyon étant très serrée, je crains que nous ne rations le train pour Grenoble.
travel and directions.en: The connection in Lyon being very tight, I'm afraid we'll miss the train to Grenoble.
travel and directions.pt: Como a conexão em Lyon é muito apertada, receio que percamos o trem para Grenoble.

travel and directions.text: Nous avons opté pour un séjour chez l'habitant afin de découvrir la région autrement que par les guides touristiques.
travel and directions.en: We opted for a homestay so as to discover the region other than through travel guides.
travel and directions.pt: Optamos por nos hospedar na casa de moradores para conhecer a região de um jeito diferente dos guias turísticos.

travel and directions.text: Le chauffeur de taxi a fait un détour considérable, sans doute en pensant que nous ne connaissions pas la ville.
travel and directions.en: The taxi driver took a considerable detour, probably thinking we didn't know the city.
travel and directions.pt: O taxista fez um desvio enorme, provavelmente achando que não conhecíamos a cidade.

travel and directions.text: Vous ne pouvez pas le manquer, c'est le grand bâtiment aux volets bleus en face de l'église.
travel and directions.en: You can't miss it, it's the big building with blue shutters opposite the church.
travel and directions.pt: Não tem como errar, é o prédio grande de janelas azuis em frente à igreja.

travel and directions.text: Partir hors saison présente l'avantage non négligeable d'éviter la foule et les prix exorbitants.
travel and directions.en: Travelling off-season has the not insignificant advantage of avoiding crowds and exorbitant prices.
travel and directions.pt: Viajar fora de temporada tem a vantagem nada desprezível de evitar multidões e preços exorbitantes.

travel and directions.text: À peine avions-nous posé nos valises à l'hôtel que Thomas voulait déjà partir explorer les environs.
travel and directions.en: No sooner had we put our bags down at the hotel than Thomas already wanted to go and explore the area.
travel and directions.pt: Mal tínhamos deixado as malas no hotel e o Thomas já queria sair para explorar os arredores.

travel and directions.text: Combien de temps faut-il compter pour aller à pied du port jusqu'au sommet de la colline ?
travel and directions.en: How long does it take to walk from the harbour to the top of the hill?
travel and directions.pt: Quanto tempo leva para ir a pé do porto até o topo da colina?

travel and directions.text: Mon passeport expire dans trois mois, ce qui risque de poser problème pour entrer dans certains pays.
travel and directions.en: My passport expires in three months, which may cause problems for entering certain countries.
travel and directions.pt: Meu passaporte vence em três meses, o que pode dar problema para entrar em alguns países.

travel and directions.text: Mieux vaut prévoir de la monnaie, car les péages de cette autoroute n'acceptent pas toujours les cartes étrangères.
travel and directions.en: Better bring some change, because the tolls on this motorway don't always accept foreign cards.
travel and directions.pt: É melhor levar dinheiro trocado, porque os pedágios dessa rodovia nem sempre aceitam cartões estrangeiros.

travel and directions.text: Il nous a fallu une bonne demi-heure pour retrouver la voiture dans ce parking souterrain labyrinthique.
travel and directions.en: It took us a good half hour to find the car in that labyrinthine underground car park.
travel and directions.pt: Levamos uma boa meia hora para encontrar o carro naquele estacionamento subterrâneo labiríntico.

travel and directions.text: Contrairement à ce que dit le panneau, le sentier côtier est fermé pour cause d'éboulement.
travel and directions.en: Contrary to what the sign says, the coastal path is closed due to a rockfall.
travel and directions.pt: Ao contrário do que diz a placa, a trilha costeira está fechada por causa de um deslizamento de pedras.

travel and directions.text: Je vous conseille de descendre à l'arrêt suivant, c'est bien plus pratique pour rejoindre la vieille ville.
travel and directions.en: I'd advise you to get off at the next stop, it's much more convenient for getting to the old town.
travel and directions.pt: Aconselho você a descer no próximo ponto, é bem mais prático para chegar à cidade velha.

travel and directions.text: Faute de places dans le train de nuit, nous nous sommes rabattus sur un vol low cost à l'aube.
travel and directions.en: For lack of seats on the night train, we fell back on a budget flight at dawn.
travel and directions.pt: Por falta de lugares no trem noturno, tivemos que nos contentar com um voo low cost de madrugada.

travel and directions.text: Ce qui m'a le plus dépaysé au Japon, c'est le silence absolu qui règne dans les transports en commun.
travel and directions.en: What felt most foreign to me in Japan was the absolute silence in public transport.
travel and directions.pt: O que mais me causou estranhamento no Japão foi o silêncio absoluto no transporte público.

travel and directions.text: Vous êtes sûr que c'est par là, parce que j'ai l'impression qu'on tourne en rond depuis tout à l'heure ?
travel and directions.en: Are you sure it's this way, because I feel like we've been going round in circles for a while?
travel and directions.pt: Você tem certeza de que é por aqui, porque tenho a impressão de que estamos andando em círculos há um tempão?

travel and directions.text: Les grèves à répétition ont tellement perturbé le réseau ferroviaire que nous avons fini par partir en covoiturage.
travel and directions.en: The repeated strikes disrupted the rail network so much that we ended up carpooling.
travel and directions.pt: As greves seguidas atrapalharam tanto a rede ferroviária que acabamos indo de carona compartilhada.

travel and directions.text: N'hésitez pas à demander aux habitants, ils se feront un plaisir de vous orienter.
travel and directions.en: Don't hesitate to ask the locals, they'll be happy to point you in the right direction.
travel and directions.pt: Não hesite em perguntar aos moradores, eles terão o maior prazer em te orientar.

travel and directions.text: L'hôtel se trouve à deux pas de la plage, mais il faut gravir une centaine de marches pour y accéder.
travel and directions.en: The hotel is a stone's throw from the beach, but you have to climb about a hundred steps to get to it.
travel and directions.pt: O hotel fica a dois passos da praia, mas é preciso subir uns cem degraus para chegar lá.

travel and directions.text: Pour peu que le vent tourne, la traversée vers la Corse risque d'être particulièrement agitée.
travel and directions.en: If the wind shifts even slightly, the crossing to Corsica may be particularly rough.
travel and directions.pt: Basta o vento mudar para que a travessia até a Córsega fique especialmente agitada.

travel and directions.text: Nous comptions visiter Rome en trois jours, ce qui, avec le recul, était d'un optimisme naïf.
travel and directions.en: We planned to see Rome in three days, which, in hindsight, was naively optimistic.
travel and directions.pt: Pretendíamos conhecer Roma em três dias, o que, olhando para trás, era de um otimismo ingênuo.

travel and directions.text: Pourriez-vous me dire si le musée est accessible en fauteuil roulant depuis l'entrée principale ?
travel and directions.en: Could you tell me whether the museum is wheelchair accessible from the main entrance?
travel and directions.pt: Você poderia me dizer se o museu tem acesso para cadeira de rodas pela entrada principal?

travel and directions.text: Dès que vous apercevrez le phare, tournez à gauche et suivez les panneaux indiquant le camping.
travel and directions.en: As soon as you spot the lighthouse, turn left and follow the signs for the campsite.
travel and directions.pt: Assim que avistar o farol, vire à esquerda e siga as placas indicando o camping.

travel and directions.text: Antoine a fait le tour de l'Amérique du Sud en sac à dos, avec pour seul budget ses économies d'étudiant.
travel and directions.en: Antoine backpacked around South America with only his student savings as a budget.
travel and directions.pt: O Antoine deu a volta na América do Sul de mochila, tendo como único orçamento suas economias de estudante.

travel and directions.text: Le vol a été retardé de quatre heures, si bien que nous sommes arrivés à l'hôtel en pleine nuit.
travel and directions.en: The flight was delayed by four hours, so we got to the hotel in the middle of the night.
travel and directions.pt: O voo atrasou quatro horas, de modo que chegamos ao hotel no meio da noite.

shopping.text: J'ai fini par craquer pour ce manteau, même s'il dépassait largement le budget que je m'étais fixé.
shopping.en: I ended up giving in and buying this coat, even though it went well over the budget I'd set myself.
shopping.pt: Acabei não resistindo e comprei esse casaco, mesmo que tenha passado bem do orçamento que eu tinha estipulado.

shopping.text: Serait-il possible d'échanger ce pull contre une taille au-dessus, sachant que je n'ai pas gardé le ticket ?
shopping.en: Would it be possible to exchange this jumper for a size up, given that I didn't keep the receipt?
shopping.pt: Seria possível trocar esse suéter por um tamanho maior, sabendo que não guardei o cupom fiscal?

shopping.text: Les soldes ont beau commencer demain, les meilleures affaires seront parties en quelques heures.
shopping.en: Even though the sales start tomorrow, the best bargains will be gone within a few hours.
shopping.pt: Por mais que as liquidações comecem amanhã, as melhores ofertas vão acabar em poucas horas.

shopping.text: Je préfère faire mes courses au marché, quitte à payer un peu plus cher pour des produits de saison.
shopping.en: I prefer to do my shopping at the market, even if it means paying a bit more for seasonal produce.
shopping.pt: Prefiro fazer compras na feira, mesmo que tenha que pagar um pouco mais caro por produtos da estação.

shopping.text: Le vendeur a tellement insisté que j'ai fini par acheter une extension de garantie dont je n'avais nul besoin.
shopping.en: The salesman insisted so much that I ended up buying an extended warranty I had no need for.
shopping.pt: O vendedor insistiu tanto que acabei comprando uma garantia estendida de que eu não precisava nem um pouco.

shopping.text: Vous faites des retouches sur place, ou faut-il s'adresser à un couturier pour raccourcir ce pantalon ?
shopping.en: Do you do alterations on site, or do I need to go to a tailor to shorten these trousers?
shopping.pt: Vocês fazem ajustes aqui na loja, ou preciso procurar uma costureira para encurtar essa calça?

shopping.text: À ce prix-là, je m'attendais à une qualité nettement supérieure, les coutures se défont déjà.
shopping.en: At that price, I expected much better quality, the seams are already coming apart.
shopping.pt: Por esse preço, eu esperava uma qualidade bem superior, as costuras já estão se desfazendo.

shopping.text: Ma sœur ne peut pas entrer dans une librairie sans en ressortir les bras chargés de livres.
shopping.en: My sister can't go into a bookshop without coming out with her arms full of books.
shopping.pt: Minha irmã não consegue entrar numa livraria sem sair com os braços cheios de livros.

shopping.text: Il paraît que cette boutique vend des articles de seconde main en excellent état à des prix défiant toute concurrence.
shopping.en: Apparently this shop sells second-hand items in excellent condition at unbeatable prices.
shopping.pt: Dizem que essa loja vende artigos de segunda mão em ótimo estado a preços imbatíveis.

shopping.text: Je me suis fait avoir, l'appareil que j'ai commandé en ligne ne correspond absolument pas à la description.
shopping.en: I got ripped off, the device I ordered online doesn't match the description at all.
shopping.pt: Me passaram a perna, o aparelho que encomendei pela internet não corresponde em nada à descrição.

shopping.text: Est-ce que vous pourriez me faire un paquet cadeau pour l'anniversaire de mon neveu, s'il vous plaît ?
shopping.en: Could you gift-wrap this for my nephew's birthday, please?
shopping.pt: Você poderia fazer um embrulho de presente para o aniversário do meu sobrinho, por favor?

shopping.text: Depuis que j'ai calculé ce que je dépensais chaque mois en vêtements, j'essaie de me raisonner.
shopping.en: Since I worked out how much I spend on clothes every month, I've been trying to be sensible.
shopping.pt: Desde que calculei quanto eu gastava por mês com roupas, tento me controlar.

shopping.text: La caissière m'a rendu la monnaie sur cinquante euros alors que je lui avais tendu un billet de vingt.
shopping.en: The cashier gave me change for fifty euros even though I'd handed her a twenty.
shopping.pt: A caixa me deu troco de cinquenta euros embora eu tivesse entregado uma nota de vinte.

shopping.text: Ces chaussures sont superbes, mais je doute qu'elles soient assez confortables pour marcher toute la journée.
shopping.en: These shoes are gorgeous, but I doubt they're comfortable enough to walk in all day.
shopping.pt: Esses sapatos são lindos, mas duvido que sejam confortáveis o bastante para andar o dia todo.

shopping.text: On n'a plus ce modèle en magasin, mais je peux vous le commander et il arrivera d'ici jeudi.
shopping.en: We don't have that model in store anymore, but I can order it for you and it'll arrive by Thursday.
shopping.pt: Não temos mais esse modelo na loja, mas posso encomendar para você e ele chega até quinta.

shopping.text: Nicolas a comparé une dizaine de sites avant de se décider pour l'ordinateur le moins cher du lot.
shopping.en: Nicolas compared about ten websites before deciding on the cheapest computer of the lot.
shopping.pt: O Nicolas comparou uns dez sites antes de se decidir pelo computador mais barato de todos.

shopping.text: Acceptez-vous les paiements sans contact, ou dois-je absolument saisir mon code ?
shopping.en: Do you accept contactless payments, or do I have to enter my PIN?
shopping.pt: Vocês aceitam pagamento por aproximação, ou preciso digitar minha senha?

shopping.text: Bien que je déteste les centres commerciaux le samedi, je n'avais pas d'autre choix que d'y aller.
shopping.en: Although I hate shopping centres on Saturdays, I had no choice but to go.
shopping.pt: Embora eu deteste shoppings no sábado, não tive outra escolha a não ser ir.

shopping.text: Cette robe vous va comme un gant, ce serait vraiment dommage de ne pas la prendre.
shopping.en: This dress fits you like a glove, it would be a real shame not to take it.
shopping.pt: Esse vestido ficou perfeito em você, seria uma pena não levar.

shopping.text: J'ai acheté ce canapé sur un coup de tête, et je dois avouer que je le regrette un peu.
shopping.en: I bought this sofa on impulse, and I must admit I regret it a bit.
shopping.pt: Comprei esse sofá por impulso e devo confessar que me arrependo um pouco.

shopping.text: Je voudrais être remboursé plutôt que de recevoir un avoir, puisque l'article était défectueux dès le départ.
shopping.en: I'd like a refund rather than a credit note, since the item was faulty from the start.
shopping.pt: Eu gostaria de ser reembolsado em vez de receber um vale-crédito, já que o produto veio com defeito desde o início.

shopping.text: Mes grands-parents ont toujours fait leurs courses chez les petits commerçants du quartier, par principe.
shopping.en: My grandparents have always shopped at the small local shops in the neighbourhood, on principle.
shopping.pt: Meus avós sempre fizeram compras nos pequenos comércios do bairro, por princípio.

shopping.text: Avez-vous ce même modèle dans une couleur un peu plus sobre, pour le bureau ?
shopping.en: Do you have this same model in a slightly more subdued colour, for the office?
shopping.pt: Vocês têm esse mesmo modelo numa cor um pouco mais sóbria, para o escritório?

shopping.text: Les frais de livraison étaient si élevés que j'ai préféré aller chercher le colis moi-même au dépôt.
shopping.en: The delivery charges were so high that I preferred to pick up the parcel myself from the depot.
shopping.pt: O frete era tão caro que preferi ir buscar o pacote eu mesmo no depósito.

shopping.text: Ne te laisse pas impressionner par l'étiquette, une réduction de soixante-dix pour cent cache souvent des prix gonflés.
shopping.en: Don't be impressed by the label, a seventy percent discount often hides inflated prices.
shopping.pt: Não se deixe impressionar pela etiqueta, um desconto de setenta por cento muitas vezes esconde preços inflados.

shopping.text: Je cherche un cadeau pour une collègue qui part à la retraite, auriez-vous une idée originale ?
shopping.en: I'm looking for a gift for a colleague who's retiring, would you have an original idea?
shopping.pt: Estou procurando um presente para uma colega que vai se aposentar, você teria alguma ideia original?

shopping.text: La file d'attente aux caisses était telle que j'ai abandonné mon chariot et je suis reparti les mains vides.
shopping.en: The queue at the checkouts was such that I abandoned my trolley and left empty-handed.
shopping.pt: A fila nos caixas estava tão grande que abandonei o carrinho e fui embora de mãos vazias.

shopping.text: Ce n'est pas donné, mais c'est un investissement qui devrait durer une bonne dizaine d'années.
shopping.en: It's not cheap, but it's an investment that should last a good ten years.
shopping.pt: Não é barato, mas é um investimento que deve durar uns bons dez anos.

shopping.text: Vous pouvez essayer autant de vêtements que vous voulez, les cabines se trouvent au fond à droite.
shopping.en: You can try on as many clothes as you like, the fitting rooms are at the back on the right.
shopping.pt: Pode experimentar quantas roupas quiser, os provadores ficam no fundo à direita.

shopping.text: Élodie s'est juré de ne plus acheter de vêtements neufs pendant un an, par conviction écologique.
shopping.en: Élodie swore not to buy any new clothes for a year, out of ecological conviction.
shopping.pt: A Élodie jurou não comprar roupas novas durante um ano, por convicção ecológica.

shopping.text: Si j'avais attendu une semaine de plus, j'aurais pu profiter de la promotion sur ce téléviseur.
shopping.en: If I'd waited one more week, I could have taken advantage of the offer on this TV.
shopping.pt: Se eu tivesse esperado mais uma semana, poderia ter aproveitado a promoção dessa televisão.

shopping.text: Le marchand de fruits m'a glissé quelques abricots en plus, en guise de remerciement pour ma fidélité.
shopping.en: The fruit seller slipped me a few extra apricots as thanks for my loyalty.
shopping.pt: O vendedor de frutas me deu alguns damascos a mais, como agradecimento pela minha fidelidade.

shopping.text: Je ne marchande jamais, mais là, le vendeur m'a lui-même proposé une remise sans que je demande quoi que ce soit.
shopping.en: I never haggle, but this time the seller offered me a discount himself without my asking for anything.
shopping.pt: Eu nunca pechincho, mas dessa vez o próprio vendedor me ofereceu um desconto sem eu pedir nada.

shopping.text: Pourriez-vous m'indiquer où se trouve le rayon bricolage, car je le cherche en vain depuis dix bonnes minutes ?
shopping.en: Could you tell me where the DIY aisle is, because I've been looking for it in vain for a good ten minutes?
shopping.pt: Você poderia me indicar onde fica a seção de ferramentas, porque estou procurando há uns bons dez minutos sem achar?

shopping.text: Les prix ont tellement augmenté que mon panier hebdomadaire me coûte désormais presque le double.
shopping.en: Prices have gone up so much that my weekly shop now costs me almost double.
shopping.pt: Os preços subiram tanto que minhas compras da semana agora custam quase o dobro.

shopping.text: J'aurais aimé trouver ce livre d'occasion, mais il est épuisé depuis des années chez l'éditeur.
shopping.en: I would have liked to find this book second-hand, but it's been out of print for years.
shopping.pt: Eu gostaria de ter encontrado esse livro usado, mas está esgotado na editora há anos.

shopping.text: Tu veux vraiment payer trois cents euros pour une paire de baskets que tu porteras deux fois ?
shopping.en: Do you really want to pay three hundred euros for a pair of trainers you'll wear twice?
shopping.pt: Você quer mesmo pagar trezentos euros num par de tênis que vai usar duas vezes?

shopping.text: Le commerçant a accepté de me mettre l'article de côté jusqu'à samedi, le temps que je réfléchisse.
shopping.en: The shopkeeper agreed to put the item aside for me until Saturday, to give me time to think.
shopping.pt: O comerciante aceitou guardar o produto para mim até sábado, enquanto eu penso.

shopping.text: Faire ses courses en ligne fait gagner du temps, certes, mais on perd le plaisir de flâner dans les allées.
shopping.en: Online shopping saves time, admittedly, but you lose the pleasure of wandering the aisles.
shopping.pt: Fazer compras pela internet economiza tempo, é verdade, mas se perde o prazer de passear pelos corredores.

shopping.text: Quoi que tu en penses, cette lampe vintage trouvée à la brocante est la meilleure affaire de l'année !
shopping.en: Whatever you think, this vintage lamp from the flea market is the bargain of the year!
shopping.pt: Pense o que quiser, essa luminária vintage achada no brechó é a melhor compra do ano!

work and meetings.text: Compte tenu des délais très serrés, je propose que nous reportions la réunion de lancement à lundi prochain.
work and meetings.en: Given the very tight deadlines, I suggest we postpone the kick-off meeting to next Monday.
work and meetings.pt: Tendo em conta os prazos muito apertados, proponho que adiemos a reunião de lançamento para a próxima segunda.

work and meetings.text: Je ne voudrais pas jouer les rabat-joie, mais ce projet me paraît irréalisable avec le budget actuel.
work and meetings.en: I don't want to be a killjoy, but this project seems unfeasible to me with the current budget.
work and meetings.pt: Não quero ser estraga-prazeres, mas esse projeto me parece inviável com o orçamento atual.

work and meetings.text: Pourriez-vous m'envoyer le compte rendu de la réunion d'hier avant la fin de la journée ?
work and meetings.en: Could you send me the minutes of yesterday's meeting before the end of the day?
work and meetings.pt: Você poderia me enviar a ata da reunião de ontem antes do fim do dia?

work and meetings.text: Sophie a été promue directrice commerciale, ce qui n'a surpris personne vu son investissement ces dernières années.
work and meetings.en: Sophie was promoted to sales director, which surprised no one given her commitment over the last few years.
work and meetings.pt: A Sophie foi promovida a diretora comercial, o que não surpreendeu ninguém, dado seu empenho nos últimos anos.

work and meetings.text: Avant de passer au point suivant, j'aimerais qu'on revienne brièvement sur les chiffres du troisième trimestre.
work and meetings.en: Before moving on to the next item, I'd like us to go back briefly to the third-quarter figures.
work and meetings.pt: Antes de passarmos ao próximo ponto, gostaria que voltássemos rapidamente aos números do terceiro trimestre.

work and meetings.text: Il est grand temps que la direction prenne la mesure du malaise qui règne dans les équipes.
work and meetings.en: It's high time management grasped the extent of the unease among the teams.
work and meetings.pt: Já passou da hora de a diretoria entender a dimensão do mal-estar que reina nas equipes.

work and meetings.text: Je me permets de vous relancer au sujet du devis que je vous ai transmis la semaine dernière.
work and meetings.en: I'm following up regarding the quote I sent you last week.
work and meetings.pt: Tomo a liberdade de retomar o contato sobre o orçamento que lhe enviei na semana passada.

work and meetings.text: Si nous ne parvenons pas à un accord d'ici vendredi, le client risque de se tourner vers la concurrence.
work and meetings.en: If we don't reach an agreement by Friday, the client may turn to the competition.
work and meetings.pt: Se não chegarmos a um acordo até sexta, o cliente pode recorrer à concorrência.

work and meetings.text: Le télétravail deux jours par semaine a nettement amélioré mon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée.
work and meetings.en: Working from home two days a week has clearly improved my work-life balance.
work and meetings.pt: O home office dois dias por semana melhorou bastante meu equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal.

work and meetings.text: Qui se charge de prendre des notes aujourd'hui, puisque Marc est en déplacement à Bruxelles ?
work and meetings.en: Who's taking notes today, since Marc is on a business trip to Brussels?
work and meetings.pt: Quem fica responsável pelas anotações hoje, já que o Marc está em viagem a Bruxelas?

work and meetings.text: J'ai l'impression que le débat s'enlise, alors tâchons de trancher avant midi.
work and meetings.en: I feel the debate is getting bogged down, so let's try to settle it before noon.
work and meetings.pt: Tenho a impressão de que o debate está empacando, então vamos tentar bater o martelo antes do meio-dia.

work and meetings.text: Mon chef m'a confié ce dossier épineux en me laissant carte blanche pour le mener à bien.
work and meetings.en: My boss handed me this thorny case, giving me carte blanche to see it through.
work and meetings.pt: Meu chefe me confiou esse caso espinhoso, me dando carta branca para levá-lo adiante.

work and meetings.text: Nous avons beau multiplier les réunions, les décisions concrètes se font toujours attendre.
work and meetings.en: However many meetings we hold, concrete decisions are still a long time coming.
work and meetings.pt: Por mais que multipliquemos as reuniões, as decisões concretas continuam demorando.

work and meetings.text: Je tiens à remercier toute l'équipe, sans qui ce lancement n'aurait jamais pu voir le jour dans les temps.
work and meetings.en: I want to thank the whole team, without whom this launch could never have happened on time.
work and meetings.pt: Quero agradecer a toda a equipe, sem a qual esse lançamento nunca teria saído a tempo.

work and meetings.text: Est-ce que quelqu'un s'oppose à ce que nous avancions la date de livraison au quinze mars ?
work and meetings.en: Does anyone object to our moving the delivery date forward to March 15th?
work and meetings.pt: Alguém se opõe a antecipar a data de entrega para quinze de março?

work and meetings.text: Après dix ans dans la même entreprise, Karim envisage sérieusement de se reconvertir dans l'enseignement.
work and meetings.en: After ten years at the same company, Karim is seriously considering retraining as a teacher.
work and meetings.pt: Depois de dez anos na mesma empresa, o Karim está pensando seriamente em mudar de carreira para o ensino.

work and meetings.text: Faute de consensus, la décision finale reviendra au comité de direction qui se réunit le mois prochain.
work and meetings.en: Lacking consensus, the final decision will fall to the management committee, which meets next month.
work and meetings.pt: Na falta de consenso, a decisão final caberá ao comitê de direção, que se reúne no mês que vem.

work and meetings.text: Ce n'est pas faute d'avoir prévenu, mais personne n'a tenu compte de mes réserves sur le calendrier.
work and meetings.en: It's not for lack of warning, but nobody took my reservations about the schedule into account.
work and meetings.pt: Não foi por falta de aviso, mas ninguém levou em conta minhas ressalvas sobre o cronograma.

work and meetings.text: Pourrions-nous caler un point rapide demain matin pour faire le bilan de la négociation ?
work and meetings.en: Could we schedule a quick catch-up tomorrow morning to review the negotiation?
work and meetings.pt: Poderíamos marcar uma conversa rápida amanhã de manhã para fazer um balanço da negociação?

work and meetings.text: Je vous saurais gré de bien vouloir me faire parvenir les pièces justificatives dans les meilleurs délais.
work and meetings.en: I would be grateful if you could send me the supporting documents as soon as possible.
work and meetings.pt: Ficaria grato se você pudesse me enviar os comprovantes o quanto antes.

work and meetings.text: Le nouveau directeur a la fâcheuse habitude de convoquer des réunions à dix-huit heures le vendredi.
work and meetings.en: The new director has the annoying habit of calling meetings at 6 p.m. on Fridays.
work and meetings.pt: O novo diretor tem o péssimo hábito de convocar reuniões às dezoito horas na sexta-feira.

work and meetings.text: Quoi qu'en dise la direction, cette restructuration va forcément entraîner des suppressions de postes.
work and meetings.en: Whatever management says, this restructuring is bound to lead to job cuts.
work and meetings.pt: Diga a diretoria o que disser, essa reestruturação vai inevitavelmente levar a cortes de vagas.

work and meetings.text: J'ai décroché le contrat, mais il a fallu batailler ferme sur les conditions de paiement.
work and meetings.en: I landed the contract, but I had to fight hard over the payment terms.
work and meetings.pt: Fechei o contrato, mas tive que brigar muito pelas condições de pagamento.

work and meetings.text: Afin que chacun puisse s'exprimer, je vous demanderai de limiter vos interventions à trois minutes.
work and meetings.en: So that everyone can speak, I'll ask you to limit your contributions to three minutes.
work and meetings.pt: Para que todos possam se manifestar, vou pedir que limitem suas falas a três minutos.

work and meetings.text: Elle a démissionné du jour au lendemain, ce qui a laissé toute l'équipe dans l'embarras.
work and meetings.en: She resigned overnight, which left the whole team in a tight spot.
work and meetings.pt: Ela pediu demissão de uma hora para outra, o que deixou toda a equipe numa situação complicada.

work and meetings.text: Si je comprends bien, vous suggérez que nous sous-traitions la partie logistique pour réduire les coûts ?
work and meetings.en: If I understand correctly, you're suggesting we outsource the logistics to cut costs?
work and meetings.pt: Se entendi bem, você está sugerindo que terceirizemos a parte de logística para reduzir os custos?

work and meetings.text: Mon entretien annuel s'est mieux passé que prévu, et j'ai même obtenu une augmentation de cinq pour cent.
work and meetings.en: My annual review went better than expected, and I even got a five percent raise.
work and meetings.pt: Minha avaliação anual foi melhor do que eu esperava, e ainda consegui um aumento de cinco por cento.

work and meetings.text: Il faudrait qu'on mette les choses à plat avec le service marketing avant que la situation ne s'envenime.
work and meetings.en: We should clear the air with the marketing department before the situation turns sour.
work and meetings.pt: Precisaríamos colocar tudo em pratos limpos com o departamento de marketing antes que a situação piore.

work and meetings.text: Je crains que la présentation ne soit pas prête à temps, à moins que quelqu'un ne me donne un coup de main.
work and meetings.en: I'm afraid the presentation won't be ready in time, unless someone gives me a hand.
work and meetings.pt: Receio que a apresentação não fique pronta a tempo, a menos que alguém me dê uma mão.

work and meetings.text: Le salon professionnel de Milan nous a permis de nouer des contacts précieux avec des distributeurs italiens.
work and meetings.en: The Milan trade fair allowed us to make valuable contacts with Italian distributors.
work and meetings.pt: A feira profissional de Milão nos permitiu fazer contatos valiosos com distribuidores italianos.

work and meetings.text: Vous auriez dû me mettre en copie de cet e-mail, j'aurais pu rectifier le tir à temps.
work and meetings.en: You should have copied me on that email, I could have corrected course in time.
work and meetings.pt: Você deveria ter me colocado em cópia nesse e-mail, eu poderia ter corrigido o rumo a tempo.

work and meetings.text: Entre les visioconférences et les mails urgents, je n'ai pas eu une minute pour avancer sur le rapport.
work and meetings.en: Between video calls and urgent emails, I haven't had a minute to make progress on the report.
work and meetings.pt: Entre as videoconferências e os e-mails urgentes, não tive um minuto para avançar no relatório.

work and meetings.text: Le stagiaire a fait preuve d'une telle rigueur que nous envisageons de lui proposer un CDI.
work and meetings.en: The intern showed such rigour that we're considering offering him a permanent contract.
work and meetings.pt: O estagiário demonstrou tanto rigor que estamos pensando em lhe oferecer um contrato efetivo.

work and meetings.text: Je propose qu'on fasse un tour de table pour que chacun donne son avis sur la nouvelle organisation.
work and meetings.en: I suggest we go round the table so everyone can give their opinion on the new organisation.
work and meetings.pt: Proponho que façamos uma rodada para que cada um dê sua opinião sobre a nova organização.

work and meetings.text: Malgré la pression, Inès a su garder son sang-froid face à un client particulièrement désagréable.
work and meetings.en: Despite the pressure, Inès managed to keep her cool with a particularly unpleasant client.
work and meetings.pt: Apesar da pressão, a Inès soube manter a calma diante de um cliente especialmente desagradável.

work and meetings.text: On m'a proposé un poste à Montréal, mais je ne suis pas sûr de vouloir tout quitter pour autant.
work and meetings.en: I've been offered a job in Montreal, but I'm not sure I want to leave everything for it.
work and meetings.pt: Me ofereceram uma vaga em Montreal, mas não sei se quero largar tudo por isso.

work and meetings.text: Les objectifs fixés pour cette année sont, à mon sens, bien trop ambitieux au vu des effectifs.
work and meetings.en: The targets set for this year are, in my view, far too ambitious given the staffing levels.
work and meetings.pt: As metas estabelecidas para este ano são, na minha opinião, ambiciosas demais tendo em vista o quadro de funcionários.

work and meetings.text: Pour éviter tout malentendu, je vous confirmerai par écrit ce que nous venons de convenir oralement.
work and meetings.en: To avoid any misunderstanding, I'll confirm in writing what we've just agreed verbally.
work and meetings.pt: Para evitar qualquer mal-entendido, vou confirmar por escrito o que acabamos de combinar verbalmente.

work and meetings.text: Ça fait trois semaines que j'attends le feu vert du service juridique pour signer ce partenariat.
work and meetings.en: I've been waiting three weeks for the legal department's green light to sign this partnership.
work and meetings.pt: Faz três semanas que estou esperando o sinal verde do jurídico para assinar essa parceria.

work and meetings.text: Bien qu'il soit le plus jeune de l'équipe, Hugo s'est imposé naturellement comme chef de projet.
work and meetings.en: Although he's the youngest on the team, Hugo naturally established himself as project manager.
work and meetings.pt: Embora seja o mais novo da equipe, o Hugo se firmou naturalmente como gerente de projeto.

family and friends.text: Depuis que ma sœur s'est installée au Canada, nous nous appelons tous les dimanches, décalage horaire oblige.
family and friends.en: Since my sister moved to Canada, we call each other every Sunday, because of the time difference.
family and friends.pt: Desde que minha irmã se mudou para o Canadá, nos falamos todo domingo, por causa do fuso horário.

family and friends.text: Mon grand-père, qui a toujours eu un caractère bien trempé, refuse catégoriquement d'aller en maison de retraite.
family and friends.en: My grandfather, who has always had a strong character, flatly refuses to go into a retirement home.
family and friends.pt: Meu avô, que sempre teve um gênio forte, se recusa categoricamente a ir para um asilo.

family and friends.text: Paul et moi nous sommes perdus de vue après le lycée, puis retrouvés par hasard vingt ans plus tard.
family and friends.en: Paul and I lost touch after high school, then ran into each other by chance twenty years later.
family and friends.pt: O Paul e eu perdemos contato depois do colégio e nos reencontramos por acaso vinte anos depois.

family and friends.text: Il faut dire que mon frère et moi ne nous sommes jamais vraiment entendus, même enfants.
family and friends.en: I must say my brother and I never really got on, even as children.
family and friends.pt: É preciso dizer que meu irmão e eu nunca nos demos muito bem, nem quando éramos crianças.

family and friends.text: Nos enfants sont maintenant grands, si bien que nous profitons enfin de nos week-ends à deux.
family and friends.en: Our children are grown up now, so we're finally enjoying our weekends as a couple.
family and friends.pt: Nossos filhos já estão grandes, então finalmente aproveitamos nossos fins de semana a dois.

family and friends.text: C'est le genre d'amie sur qui on peut compter à n'importe quelle heure du jour ou de la nuit.
family and friends.en: She's the kind of friend you can count on at any hour of the day or night.
family and friends.pt: É o tipo de amiga com quem se pode contar a qualquer hora do dia ou da noite.

family and friends.text: Ma belle-mère a la fâcheuse tendance à se mêler de tout ce qui concerne l'éducation de nos enfants.
family and friends.en: My mother-in-law has an unfortunate tendency to meddle in everything to do with raising our children.
family and friends.pt: Minha sogra tem a mania de se meter em tudo que diz respeito à educação dos nossos filhos.

family and friends.text: Si tu avais été là pour le mariage de Clara, tu aurais vu ton oncle danser le rock jusqu'à l'aube !
family and friends.en: If you'd been at Clara's wedding, you'd have seen your uncle dancing rock'n'roll until dawn!
family and friends.pt: Se você tivesse ido ao casamento da Clara, teria visto seu tio dançando rock até o amanhecer!

family and friends.text: Nous avons organisé une fête surprise pour les quarante ans de Léa, et elle ne s'est doutée de rien.
family and friends.en: We threw a surprise party for Léa's fortieth birthday, and she didn't suspect a thing.
family and friends.pt: Organizamos uma festa surpresa para os quarenta anos da Léa, e ela não desconfiou de nada.

family and friends.text: J'ai beau adorer mes neveux, au bout d'une semaine de vacances ensemble, j'ai besoin de souffler.
family and friends.en: Much as I adore my nephews, after a week's holiday together I need a breather.
family and friends.pt: Por mais que eu adore meus sobrinhos, depois de uma semana de férias juntos, preciso respirar.

family and friends.text: Quand est-ce que tu comptes nous présenter cette fameuse Juliette dont tu nous parles sans arrêt ?
family and friends.en: When are you planning to introduce us to this famous Juliette you keep talking about?
family and friends.pt: Quando você pretende nos apresentar essa famosa Juliette de quem fala o tempo todo?

family and friends.text: Mes parents se sont rencontrés dans un bal de village en 1978 et ne se sont plus jamais quittés.
family and friends.en: My parents met at a village dance in 1978 and have never been apart since.
family and friends.pt: Meus pais se conheceram num baile de interior em 1978 e nunca mais se separaram.

family and friends.text: Une brouille stupide au sujet d'un héritage a fini par diviser toute la famille pendant des années.
family and friends.en: A stupid quarrel over an inheritance ended up dividing the whole family for years.
family and friends.pt: Uma briga boba por causa de uma herança acabou dividindo a família inteira por anos.

family and friends.text: Mon meilleur ami m'a demandé d'être le parrain de sa fille, ce qui m'a profondément touché.
family and friends.en: My best friend asked me to be his daughter's godfather, which touched me deeply.
family and friends.pt: Meu melhor amigo me pediu para ser padrinho da filha dele, o que me tocou profundamente.

family and friends.text: Même si on ne se voit plus que deux fois par an, notre amitié n'a pas pris une ride.
family and friends.en: Even though we only see each other twice a year now, our friendship hasn't aged a day.
family and friends.pt: Mesmo que agora a gente só se veja duas vezes por ano, nossa amizade continua intacta.

family and friends.text: Ma fille ado passe ses journées enfermée dans sa chambre, et je ne sais plus comment communiquer avec elle.
family and friends.en: My teenage daughter spends her days shut in her room, and I no longer know how to communicate with her.
family and friends.pt: Minha filha adolescente passa os dias trancada no quarto, e não sei mais como me comunicar com ela.

family and friends.text: Les repas de famille chez nous finissent invariablement en débats politiques animés autour du fromage.
family and friends.en: Family meals at our house invariably end in heated political debates over the cheese course.
family and friends.pt: Os almoços de família lá em casa sempre terminam em debates políticos acalorados na hora do queijo.

family and friends.text: Je trouve que tu es un peu dur avec ton fils, il fait pourtant de son mieux à l'école.
family and friends.en: I think you're a bit hard on your son, he's doing his best at school, after all.
family and friends.pt: Acho que você está sendo meio duro com seu filho, ele está se esforçando na escola.

family and friends.text: Grâce aux réseaux sociaux, j'ai retrouvé des cousins éloignés dont j'ignorais jusqu'à l'existence.
family and friends.en: Thanks to social media, I found distant cousins whose very existence I was unaware of.
family and friends.pt: Graças às redes sociais, reencontrei primos distantes cuja existência eu nem conhecia.

family and friends.text: Vincent est du genre à oublier les anniversaires, mais il se rattrape toujours avec un geste adorable.
family and friends.en: Vincent is the type to forget birthdays, but he always makes up for it with a lovely gesture.
family and friends.pt: O Vincent é do tipo que esquece aniversários, mas sempre compensa com um gesto adorável.

family and friends.text: Ça te dirait de venir passer Noël avec nous, puisque tes parents seront en voyage cette année ?
family and friends.en: Would you like to come and spend Christmas with us, since your parents will be away this year?
family and friends.pt: Que tal passar o Natal com a gente, já que seus pais vão estar viajando este ano?

family and friends.text: Ma grand-mère nous racontait souvent la guerre, mais toujours avec une pudeur qui me bouleversait.
family and friends.en: My grandmother often told us about the war, but always with a reserve that moved me deeply.
family and friends.pt: Minha avó contava muito sobre a guerra, mas sempre com um pudor que me comovia.

family and friends.text: On a eu une sacrée dispute avec Manon, mais on s'est réconciliées le soir même autour d'un verre.
family and friends.en: Manon and I had a huge row, but we made up that same evening over a drink.
family and friends.pt: Eu e a Manon tivemos uma briga feia, mas fizemos as pazes na mesma noite tomando alguma coisa.

family and friends.text: Mes beaux-parents ont la gentillesse de garder les petits chaque mercredi après-midi.
family and friends.en: My in-laws are kind enough to look after the little ones every Wednesday afternoon.
family and friends.pt: Meus sogros têm a gentileza de cuidar das crianças toda quarta à tarde.

family and friends.text: Il n'y a rien de tel qu'un week-end entre amis à la campagne pour recharger les batteries.
family and friends.en: There's nothing like a weekend with friends in the countryside to recharge your batteries.
family and friends.pt: Não há nada como um fim de semana com amigos no campo para recarregar as baterias.

family and friends.text: Depuis la naissance des jumeaux, Alice et Romain n'ont plus une minute à eux.
family and friends.en: Since the twins were born, Alice and Romain haven't had a minute to themselves.
family and friends.pt: Desde o nascimento dos gêmeos, a Alice e o Romain não têm mais um minuto para si.

family and friends.text: Je ne m'attendais pas à ce que mon père, si réservé d'habitude, fonde en larmes pendant son discours.
family and friends.en: I didn't expect my father, usually so reserved, to burst into tears during his speech.
family and friends.pt: Eu não esperava que meu pai, normalmente tão reservado, caísse no choro durante o discurso.

family and friends.text: Nous sommes une famille recomposée, avec cinq enfants qui ont appris tant bien que mal à vivre ensemble.
family and friends.en: We're a blended family, with five children who've learned, somehow or other, to live together.
family and friends.pt: Somos uma família recomposta, com cinco filhos que aprenderam, aos trancos e barrancos, a viver juntos.

family and friends.text: Tu pourrais au moins prendre des nouvelles de ta tante, elle sort à peine de l'hôpital.
family and friends.en: You could at least check on your aunt, she's only just out of hospital.
family and friends.pt: Você podia pelo menos perguntar como está sua tia, ela acabou de sair do hospital.

family and friends.text: Mon cousin et moi avons tellement de points communs qu'on nous prend souvent pour des frères.
family and friends.en: My cousin and I have so much in common that people often take us for brothers.
family and friends.pt: Meu primo e eu temos tanta coisa em comum que muitas vezes nos confundem com irmãos.

family and friends.text: C'est en traversant ensemble cette période difficile que nous avons compris qui étaient nos vrais amis.
family and friends.en: It was by going through that difficult period together that we understood who our real friends were.
family and friends.pt: Foi passando juntos por esse período difícil que entendemos quem eram nossos verdadeiros amigos.

family and friends.text: Bien qu'ils soient divorcés depuis dix ans, mes parents s'entendent mieux aujourd'hui qu'à l'époque de leur mariage.
family and friends.en: Although they've been divorced for ten years, my parents get on better today than when they were married.
family and friends.pt: Embora estejam divorciados há dez anos, meus pais se dão melhor hoje do que na época do casamento.

family and friends.text: Tu te souviens de cet été où on avait campé trois semaines dans les Pyrénées sans un sou ?
family and friends.en: Do you remember that summer when we camped for three weeks in the Pyrenees without a penny?
family and friends.pt: Você lembra daquele verão em que acampamos três semanas nos Pirineus sem um tostão?

family and friends.text: Ma mère m'appelle tous les soirs, au cas où il me serait arrivé quelque chose dans la journée.
family and friends.en: My mother calls me every evening, in case something happened to me during the day.
family and friends.pt: Minha mãe me liga toda noite, caso tenha me acontecido alguma coisa durante o dia.

family and friends.text: Entre nous, je trouve que Fabien a beaucoup changé depuis qu'il fréquente cette nouvelle bande.
family and friends.en: Between us, I think Fabien has changed a lot since he started hanging out with that new crowd.
family and friends.pt: Cá entre nós, acho que o Fabien mudou muito desde que começou a andar com essa nova turma.

family and friends.text: Nos anciens collègues sont devenus de véritables amis, au point que nous partons désormais en vacances ensemble.
family and friends.en: Our former colleagues have become real friends, to the point that we now go on holiday together.
family and friends.pt: Nossos antigos colegas viraram amigos de verdade, a ponto de agora viajarmos de férias juntos.

family and friends.text: Mon petit frère a toujours été le chouchou de la famille, ce qui m'agaçait prodigieusement quand j'étais petite.
family and friends.en: My little brother was always the family favourite, which annoyed me enormously when I was little.
family and friends.pt: Meu irmão caçula sempre foi o queridinho da família, o que me irritava profundamente quando eu era pequena.

family and friends.text: Je lui ai prêté de l'argent il y a deux ans, et depuis, il fait comme si de rien n'était.
family and friends.en: I lent him money two years ago, and since then he's been acting as if nothing happened.
family and friends.pt: Emprestei dinheiro para ele há dois anos, e desde então ele age como se nada tivesse acontecido.

family and friends.text: Que vous soyez de passage à Nantes ou non, sachez que vous serez toujours les bienvenus chez nous.
family and friends.en: Whether or not you're passing through Nantes, know that you'll always be welcome at our place.
family and friends.pt: Estejam vocês de passagem por Nantes ou não, saibam que serão sempre bem-vindos na nossa casa.

family and friends.text: Ma fille m'a annoncé qu'elle allait se marier en Grèce, sur une île dont je n'avais jamais entendu parler.
family and friends.en: My daughter told me she's getting married in Greece, on an island I'd never heard of.
family and friends.pt: Minha filha me contou que vai se casar na Grécia, numa ilha de que eu nunca tinha ouvido falar.

health and the doctor.text: Cela fait une dizaine de jours que je traîne une toux sèche qui m'empêche de dormir la nuit.
health and the doctor.en: For about ten days I've had a dry cough that keeps me awake at night.
health and the doctor.pt: Faz uns dez dias que estou com uma tosse seca que não me deixa dormir à noite.

health and the doctor.text: Le médecin m'a prescrit des antibiotiques, tout en précisant qu'il fallait suivre le traitement jusqu'au bout.
health and the doctor.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics, while stressing that I had to finish the course.
health and the doctor.pt: O médico me receitou antibióticos, frisando que era preciso seguir o tratamento até o fim.

health and the doctor.text: Depuis que je me suis remis au sport, je dors nettement mieux et je suis beaucoup moins stressé.
health and the doctor.en: Since I got back into sport, I sleep much better and I'm a lot less stressed.
health and the doctor.pt: Desde que voltei a fazer exercício, durmo bem melhor e estou muito menos estressado.

health and the doctor.text: Pourriez-vous me dire si ce médicament est compatible avec la pilule que je prends déjà ?
health and the doctor.en: Could you tell me whether this medicine is compatible with the pill I'm already taking?
health and the doctor.pt: Você poderia me dizer se esse remédio é compatível com a pílula que eu já tomo?

health and the doctor.text: Il a fallu attendre trois mois pour obtenir un rendez-vous chez le dermatologue, ce qui est inadmissible.
health and the doctor.en: I had to wait three months to get an appointment with the dermatologist, which is unacceptable.
health and the doctor.pt: Tive que esperar três meses para conseguir uma consulta com o dermatologista, o que é inadmissível.

health and the doctor.text: Si la fièvre ne baisse pas d'ici demain, n'hésitez pas à revenir me voir ou à appeler les urgences.
health and the doctor.en: If the fever doesn't go down by tomorrow, don't hesitate to come back or call emergency services.
health and the doctor.pt: Se a febre não baixar até amanhã, não hesite em voltar aqui ou ligar para o pronto-socorro.

health and the doctor.text: Je me suis tordu la cheville en descendant l'escalier, et elle a doublé de volume en une heure.
health and the doctor.en: I twisted my ankle going down the stairs, and it doubled in size in an hour.
health and the doctor.pt: Torci o tornozelo descendo a escada, e ele dobrou de tamanho em uma hora.

health and the doctor.text: Ma généraliste m'a orienté vers un cardiologue, par simple précaution, m'a-t-elle assuré.
health and the doctor.en: My GP referred me to a cardiologist, purely as a precaution, she assured me.
health and the doctor.pt: Minha clínica geral me encaminhou para um cardiologista, por simples precaução, ela me garantiu.

health and the doctor.text: Ne vous inquiétez pas outre mesure, ce genre de symptôme disparaît généralement au bout de quelques jours.
health and the doctor.en: Don't worry unduly, this kind of symptom usually goes away after a few days.
health and the doctor.pt: Não se preocupe demais, esse tipo de sintoma costuma desaparecer depois de alguns dias.

health and the doctor.text: Je ne supporte plus ces migraines à répétition qui me clouent au lit plusieurs fois par mois.
health and the doctor.en: I can't stand these recurring migraines that confine me to bed several times a month.
health and the doctor.pt: Não aguento mais essas enxaquecas frequentes que me deixam de cama várias vezes por mês.

health and the doctor.text: Bien qu'il ait arrêté de fumer il y a cinq ans, Gérard continue de souffrir de problèmes respiratoires.
health and the doctor.en: Although he quit smoking five years ago, Gérard still suffers from breathing problems.
health and the doctor.pt: Embora tenha parado de fumar há cinco anos, o Gérard continua sofrendo de problemas respiratórios.

health and the doctor.text: Est-ce que je dois être à jeun pour la prise de sang, ou est-ce que je peux boire un café ?
health and the doctor.en: Do I need to fast for the blood test, or can I have a coffee?
health and the doctor.pt: Preciso estar em jejum para o exame de sangue, ou posso tomar um café?

health and the doctor.text: Le kiné m'a conseillé de faire ces exercices tous les matins, faute de quoi la douleur risque de revenir.
health and the doctor.en: The physio advised me to do these exercises every morning, otherwise the pain may come back.
health and the doctor.pt: O fisioterapeuta me aconselhou a fazer esses exercícios toda manhã, senão a dor pode voltar.

health and the doctor.text: J'ai attrapé la grippe la semaine où j'avais le plus de travail, c'est toujours comme ça !
health and the doctor.en: I caught the flu the week I had the most work, it's always like that!
health and the doctor.pt: Peguei gripe justo na semana em que eu tinha mais trabalho, é sempre assim!

health and the doctor.text: Vous devriez ralentir un peu le rythme, sans quoi vous allez finir par faire un burn-out.
health and the doctor.en: You should slow down a bit, otherwise you'll end up burning out.
health and the doctor.pt: Você deveria diminuir um pouco o ritmo, senão vai acabar tendo um burnout.

health and the doctor.text: D'après les résultats des analyses, votre taux de cholestérol est un peu élevé, sans être alarmant pour autant.
health and the doctor.en: According to the test results, your cholesterol level is a bit high, without being alarming.
health and the doctor.pt: Segundo os resultados dos exames, sua taxa de colesterol está um pouco alta, mas nada alarmante.

health and the doctor.text: Mon fils s'est cassé le bras en tombant de vélo, et il en a pour six semaines de plâtre.
health and the doctor.en: My son broke his arm falling off his bike, and he's in a cast for six weeks.
health and the doctor.pt: Meu filho quebrou o braço caindo da bicicleta, e vai ficar seis semanas engessado.

health and the doctor.text: La pharmacienne m'a recommandé un sirop à base de plantes, mais je doute de son efficacité.
health and the doctor.en: The pharmacist recommended a herbal syrup, but I doubt it works.
health and the doctor.pt: A farmacêutica me recomendou um xarope à base de ervas, mas duvido que seja eficaz.

health and the doctor.text: Depuis l'opération, ma mère se remet doucement, même si elle se fatigue encore très vite.
health and the doctor.en: Since the operation, my mother has been recovering slowly, though she still tires very quickly.
health and the doctor.pt: Desde a cirurgia, minha mãe está se recuperando aos poucos, embora ainda se canse muito rápido.

health and the doctor.text: Avez-vous des antécédents familiaux de diabète ou de maladies cardiovasculaires dont je devrais être au courant ?
health and the doctor.en: Do you have a family history of diabetes or cardiovascular disease that I should know about?
health and the doctor.pt: Você tem histórico familiar de diabetes ou doenças cardiovasculares que eu deveria saber?

health and the doctor.text: J'ai une sainte horreur des piqûres, alors je repousse sans cesse mon rappel de vaccin.
health and the doctor.en: I have a deep horror of injections, so I keep putting off my booster jab.
health and the doctor.pt: Tenho pavor de injeção, então vivo adiando meu reforço da vacina.

health and the doctor.text: Le dentiste a dû m'arracher une dent de sagesse, et j'ai eu la joue gonflée pendant trois jours.
health and the doctor.en: The dentist had to pull out a wisdom tooth, and my cheek was swollen for three days.
health and the doctor.pt: O dentista teve que arrancar um dente do siso, e fiquei com a bochecha inchada por três dias.

health and the doctor.text: Il est fortement déconseillé de conduire pendant les vingt-quatre heures qui suivent l'anesthésie.
health and the doctor.en: Driving is strongly discouraged for twenty-four hours after the anaesthetic.
health and the doctor.pt: É altamente desaconselhado dirigir nas vinte e quatro horas seguintes à anestesia.

health and the doctor.text: Je me sens patraque depuis ce matin, je crois que je couve quelque chose.
health and the doctor.en: I've been feeling under the weather since this morning, I think I'm coming down with something.
health and the doctor.pt: Estou me sentindo meio mal desde hoje de manhã, acho que estou ficando doente.

health and the doctor.text: Ma sœur, qui est infirmière, m'a convaincu de consulter avant que ce grain de beauté ne s'aggrave.
health and the doctor.en: My sister, who's a nurse, convinced me to see a doctor before that mole got worse.
health and the doctor.pt: Minha irmã, que é enfermeira, me convenceu a ir ao médico antes que essa pinta piorasse.

health and the doctor.text: Vous prendrez un comprimé matin et soir pendant une semaine, de préférence au cours du repas.
health and the doctor.en: Take one tablet morning and evening for a week, preferably with a meal.
health and the doctor.pt: Tome um comprimido de manhã e à noite durante uma semana, de preferência durante a refeição.

health and the doctor.text: Si j'avais écouté mon médecin, je ne me serais pas retrouvé aux urgences en pleine nuit.
health and the doctor.en: If I'd listened to my doctor, I wouldn't have ended up in A&E in the middle of the night.
