health and the doctor.pt: Se eu tivesse ouvido meu médico, não teria ido parar no pronto-socorro no meio da noite.

health and the doctor.text: On m'a mis en arrêt maladie pour quinze jours, le temps que mon dos se rétablisse complètement.
health and the doctor.en: I've been signed off sick for two weeks, to give my back time to recover completely.
health and the doctor.pt: Me deram atestado de quinze dias, até minhas costas se recuperarem completamente.

health and the doctor.text: Le sommeil, l'alimentation et l'activité physique sont, selon mon médecin, les trois piliers d'une bonne santé.
health and the doctor.en: Sleep, diet and physical activity are, according to my doctor, the three pillars of good health.
health and the doctor.pt: Sono, alimentação e atividade física são, segundo meu médico, os três pilares de uma boa saúde.

health and the doctor.text: Cette allergie au pollen me gâche chaque printemps, malgré tous les traitements que j'ai essayés.
health and the doctor.en: This pollen allergy ruins every spring for me, despite all the treatments I've tried.
health and the doctor.pt: Essa alergia a pólen estraga toda primavera para mim, apesar de todos os tratamentos que já tentei.

health and the doctor.text: Docteur, est-ce grave si j'ai oublié de prendre mon médicament deux jours de suite ?
health and the doctor.en: Doctor, is it serious if I forgot to take my medicine two days in a row?
health and the doctor.pt: Doutor, é grave se eu esqueci de tomar o remédio dois dias seguidos?

health and the doctor.text: Elle a beau se dire en pleine forme, je la trouve amaigrie et je m'inquiète pour elle.
health and the doctor.en: However much she claims to be in great shape, I think she's lost weight and I'm worried about her.
health and the doctor.pt: Por mais que ela diga que está ótima, acho que emagreceu e estou preocupado com ela.

health and the doctor.text: Le médecin de garde n'a pas pu se déplacer, si bien que nous avons dû emmener Lucas à l'hôpital.
health and the doctor.en: The on-call doctor couldn't come out, so we had to take Lucas to hospital.
health and the doctor.pt: O médico de plantão não pôde vir, então tivemos que levar o Lucas ao hospital.

health and the doctor.text: Je vous conseille de vous faire vacciner contre la grippe avant l'hiver, surtout à votre âge.
health and the doctor.en: I advise you to get a flu jab before winter, especially at your age.
health and the doctor.pt: Aconselho você a se vacinar contra a gripe antes do inverno, principalmente na sua idade.

health and the doctor.text: Depuis que je médite dix minutes par jour, mes crises d'angoisse se sont considérablement espacées.
health and the doctor.en: Since I started meditating ten minutes a day, my anxiety attacks have become much less frequent.
health and the doctor.pt: Desde que comecei a meditar dez minutos por dia, minhas crises de ansiedade ficaram bem mais espaçadas.

health and the doctor.text: Ma mutuelle ne rembourse qu'une partie des lunettes, ce qui fait quand même une sacrée somme à débourser.
health and the doctor.en: My health insurance only covers part of the cost of glasses, which still leaves quite a sum to pay out.
health and the doctor.pt: Meu plano de saúde só reembolsa parte dos óculos, o que ainda dá uma bela quantia para desembolsar.

health and the doctor.text: Rien ne sert de vous gaver de vitamines si vous continuez à dormir cinq heures par nuit.
health and the doctor.en: There's no point stuffing yourself with vitamins if you keep sleeping five hours a night.
health and the doctor.pt: Não adianta se entupir de vitaminas se você continuar dormindo cinco horas por noite.

health and the doctor.text: J'ai le nez bouché, la gorge en feu et des courbatures partout, bref, je suis au fond du trou.
health and the doctor.en: My nose is blocked, my throat's on fire and I ache all over, in short, I'm at rock bottom.
health and the doctor.pt: Estou com o nariz entupido, a garganta pegando fogo e dor no corpo todo, enfim, estou acabado.

health and the doctor.text: Le chirurgien s'est voulu rassurant, mais je ne peux pas m'empêcher d'appréhender l'intervention.
health and the doctor.en: The surgeon tried to be reassuring, but I can't help dreading the operation.
health and the doctor.pt: O cirurgião tentou me tranquilizar, mas não consigo deixar de temer a cirurgia.

health and the doctor.text: Votre tension est parfaitement normale, il n'y a donc aucune raison de modifier votre traitement pour l'instant.
health and the doctor.en: Your blood pressure is perfectly normal, so there's no reason to change your treatment for now.
health and the doctor.pt: Sua pressão está perfeitamente normal, então não há motivo para mudar seu tratamento por enquanto.

weather and seasons.text: Il a plu des cordes toute la matinée, si bien que le pique-nique prévu a dû être annulé.
weather and seasons.en: It poured all morning, so the planned picnic had to be cancelled.
weather and seasons.pt: Choveu canivete a manhã toda, de modo que o piquenique planejado teve que ser cancelado.

weather and seasons.text: Bien que nous soyons en novembre, il fait encore si doux qu'on pourrait se croire au printemps.
weather and seasons.en: Although it's November, it's still so mild you'd think it was spring.
weather and seasons.pt: Embora estejamos em novembro, ainda está tão ameno que dá para pensar que é primavera.

weather and seasons.text: Les météorologues annoncent une vague de chaleur sans précédent pour la fin de la semaine.
weather and seasons.en: Forecasters are predicting an unprecedented heatwave for the end of the week.
weather and seasons.pt: Os meteorologistas preveem uma onda de calor sem precedentes para o fim da semana.

weather and seasons.text: À force de vivre en Bretagne, j'ai appris à ne jamais sortir sans un imperméable dans mon sac.
weather and seasons.en: From living in Brittany, I've learned never to go out without a raincoat in my bag.
weather and seasons.pt: De tanto morar na Bretanha, aprendi a nunca sair sem uma capa de chuva na bolsa.

weather and seasons.text: Il fait un froid de canard ce matin, n'oublie surtout pas ton écharpe et tes gants !
weather and seasons.en: It's freezing cold this morning, whatever you do, don't forget your scarf and gloves!
weather and seasons.pt: Está um frio de rachar hoje de manhã, não esqueça de jeito nenhum o cachecol e as luvas!

weather and seasons.text: L'automne est sans conteste ma saison préférée, avec ses couleurs flamboyantes et ses matins brumeux.
weather and seasons.en: Autumn is without question my favourite season, with its blazing colours and misty mornings.
weather and seasons.pt: O outono é sem dúvida minha estação preferida, com suas cores flamejantes e suas manhãs de neblina.

weather and seasons.text: Si le vent continue de souffler aussi fort, les ferries risquent d'être suspendus jusqu'à demain.
weather and seasons.en: If the wind keeps blowing this hard, the ferries may be suspended until tomorrow.
weather and seasons.pt: Se o vento continuar soprando tão forte, as balsas podem ser suspensas até amanhã.

weather and seasons.text: On dirait que l'orage approche, on ferait mieux de rentrer avant de se faire tremper.
weather and seasons.en: Looks like the storm's coming, we'd better head back before we get soaked.
weather and seasons.pt: Parece que a tempestade está chegando, é melhor voltarmos antes de ficarmos encharcados.

weather and seasons.text: Les étés sont de plus en plus caniculaires, ce qui inquiète sérieusement les agriculteurs de la région.
weather and seasons.en: Summers are getting hotter and hotter, which seriously worries the region's farmers.
weather and seasons.pt: Os verões estão cada vez mais escaldantes, o que preocupa seriamente os agricultores da região.

weather and seasons.text: Tu crois qu'il va neiger assez pour que les enfants puissent faire de la luge ce week-end ?
weather and seasons.en: Do you think it'll snow enough for the kids to go sledging this weekend?
weather and seasons.pt: Você acha que vai nevar o suficiente para as crianças andarem de trenó neste fim de semana?

weather and seasons.text: Malgré un ciel menaçant, nous avons maintenu la randonnée, et nous avons bien fait.
weather and seasons.en: Despite a threatening sky, we went ahead with the hike, and we were right to.
weather and seasons.pt: Apesar do céu ameaçador, mantivemos a trilha, e fizemos bem.

weather and seasons.text: Il paraît que cet hiver sera particulièrement rigoureux, alors j'ai fait réviser la chaudière dès septembre.
weather and seasons.en: Apparently this winter will be particularly harsh, so I had the boiler serviced back in September.
weather and seasons.pt: Dizem que este inverno vai ser especialmente rigoroso, então mandei revisar a caldeira já em setembro.

weather and seasons.text: Le brouillard était tellement épais ce matin qu'on n'y voyait pas à dix mètres sur la route.
weather and seasons.en: The fog was so thick this morning you couldn't see ten metres ahead on the road.
weather and seasons.pt: A neblina estava tão densa hoje de manhã que não dava para enxergar dez metros na estrada.

weather and seasons.text: Quel temps de chien, on se croirait en plein mois de février alors qu'on est en juin !
weather and seasons.en: What awful weather, you'd think it was February when it's actually June!
weather and seasons.pt: Que tempo horrível, parece pleno fevereiro e estamos em junho!

weather and seasons.text: Avec ce réchauffement climatique, les stations de ski de moyenne montagne ont du souci à se faire.
weather and seasons.en: With global warming, mid-altitude ski resorts have reason to worry.
weather and seasons.pt: Com esse aquecimento global, as estações de esqui de média montanha têm motivo para se preocupar.

weather and seasons.text: Le printemps a tardé à arriver cette année, mais les cerisiers sont enfin en fleur.
weather and seasons.en: Spring was slow to arrive this year, but the cherry trees are finally in bloom.
weather and seasons.pt: A primavera demorou a chegar este ano, mas as cerejeiras finalmente estão em flor.

weather and seasons.text: Pourvu qu'il fasse beau samedi, sinon il faudra organiser la fête dans le salon plutôt que dans le jardin.
weather and seasons.en: Let's hope the weather's nice on Saturday, otherwise we'll have to hold the party in the living room rather than the garden.
weather and seasons.pt: Tomara que faça sol no sábado, senão vamos ter que fazer a festa na sala em vez do jardim.

weather and seasons.text: Les orages de grêle de la nuit dernière ont ravagé une bonne partie des vignes du Beaujolais.
weather and seasons.en: Last night's hailstorms devastated a large part of the Beaujolais vineyards.
weather and seasons.pt: As tempestades de granizo da noite passada devastaram boa parte dos vinhedos do Beaujolais.

weather and seasons.text: J'ai beau adorer l'été, je supporte de moins en moins ces nuits où le thermomètre ne descend pas sous les vingt-cinq degrés.
weather and seasons.en: Much as I love summer, I find it harder and harder to bear nights when the thermometer doesn't drop below twenty-five degrees.
weather and seasons.pt: Por mais que eu adore o verão, suporto cada vez menos essas noites em que o termômetro não desce abaixo dos vinte e cinco graus.

weather and seasons.text: On annonce des gelées tardives, donc je vais rentrer les plantes du balcon par précaution.
weather and seasons.en: Late frosts are forecast, so I'm going to bring the balcony plants inside as a precaution.
weather and seasons.pt: Estão prevendo geadas tardias, então vou recolher as plantas da varanda por precaução.

weather and seasons.text: Rien ne vaut une promenade en forêt par un bel après-midi d'octobre, quand les feuilles craquent sous les pieds.
weather and seasons.en: Nothing beats a walk in the forest on a fine October afternoon, when the leaves crunch underfoot.
weather and seasons.pt: Nada como um passeio na floresta numa bela tarde de outubro, quando as folhas estalam sob os pés.

weather and seasons.text: Il a neigé toute la nuit, et la ville s'est réveillée sous un épais manteau blanc.
weather and seasons.en: It snowed all night, and the city woke up under a thick white blanket.
weather and seasons.pt: Nevou a noite toda, e a cidade amanheceu coberta por um espesso manto branco.

weather and seasons.text: Les températures devraient chuter d'une dizaine de degrés d'ici jeudi, avec l'arrivée d'une masse d'air polaire.
weather and seasons.en: Temperatures should drop by around ten degrees by Thursday, with the arrival of a polar air mass.
weather and seasons.pt: As temperaturas devem cair uns dez graus até quinta, com a chegada de uma massa de ar polar.

weather and seasons.text: Je n'arrive pas à me faire à ces journées d'hiver où il fait nuit dès cinq heures.
weather and seasons.en: I can't get used to these winter days when it's dark by five o'clock.
weather and seasons.pt: Não consigo me acostumar com esses dias de inverno em que escurece já às cinco horas.

weather and seasons.text: Après des semaines de sécheresse, cette pluie fine est une véritable bénédiction pour le jardin.
weather and seasons.en: After weeks of drought, this light rain is a real blessing for the garden.
weather and seasons.pt: Depois de semanas de seca, essa chuva fina é uma verdadeira bênção para o jardim.

weather and seasons.text: Le mistral a soufflé si fort qu'il a arraché une partie des tuiles de notre toit.
weather and seasons.en: The mistral blew so hard it tore off some of the tiles on our roof.
weather and seasons.pt: O mistral soprou tão forte que arrancou parte das telhas do nosso telhado.

weather and seasons.text: Selon la météo, il y aurait des éclaircies en fin d'après-midi, mais je n'y crois qu'à moitié.
weather and seasons.en: According to the forecast, there should be sunny spells late in the afternoon, but I only half believe it.
weather and seasons.pt: Segundo a previsão, deve abrir o tempo no fim da tarde, mas só acredito pela metade.

weather and seasons.text: C'est le genre de chaleur humide qui vous colle à la peau dès que vous mettez le nez dehors.
weather and seasons.en: It's the kind of humid heat that sticks to your skin as soon as you step outside.
weather and seasons.pt: É aquele tipo de calor úmido que gruda na pele assim que você põe o pé para fora.

weather and seasons.text: Profitons-en pour aller à la plage, puisqu'on annonce de la pluie pour toute la semaine prochaine.
weather and seasons.en: Let's make the most of it and go to the beach, since rain is forecast for the whole of next week.
weather and seasons.pt: Vamos aproveitar para ir à praia, já que estão prevendo chuva para a semana que vem inteira.

weather and seasons.text: Quand j'étais enfant, il neigeait chaque hiver dans notre village, alors qu'aujourd'hui c'est devenu exceptionnel.
weather and seasons.en: When I was a child, it snowed every winter in our village, whereas today it's become exceptional.
weather and seasons.pt: Quando eu era criança, nevava todo inverno na nossa cidadezinha, enquanto hoje virou algo excepcional.

weather and seasons.text: Les vacanciers ont été évacués des campings en raison des risques d'inondation liés aux pluies torrentielles.
weather and seasons.en: Holidaymakers were evacuated from campsites because of the flood risk from torrential rain.
weather and seasons.pt: Os turistas foram retirados dos campings por causa do risco de enchente ligado às chuvas torrenciais.

weather and seasons.text: Tu as vu ce coucher de soleil, on dirait que le ciel tout entier est en feu !
weather and seasons.en: Have you seen that sunset, it looks like the whole sky is on fire!
weather and seasons.pt: Você viu esse pôr do sol, parece que o céu inteiro está pegando fogo!

weather and seasons.text: Il fait un temps idéal pour une balade à vélo, ni trop chaud ni trop froid.
weather and seasons.en: It's ideal weather for a bike ride, neither too hot nor too cold.
weather and seasons.pt: Está um tempo ideal para um passeio de bicicleta, nem muito quente nem muito frio.

weather and seasons.text: Le verglas a provoqué une série d'accidents sur la départementale, et les secours ont mis des heures à intervenir.
weather and seasons.en: Black ice caused a series of accidents on the local road, and emergency services took hours to respond.
weather and seasons.pt: O gelo na pista causou uma série de acidentes na estrada estadual, e o socorro levou horas para chegar.

weather and seasons.text: Je préfère de loin le froid sec de la montagne à la grisaille humide de Paris.
weather and seasons.en: I far prefer the dry cold of the mountains to the damp greyness of Paris.
weather and seasons.pt: Prefiro muito mais o frio seco da montanha ao cinzento úmido de Paris.

weather and seasons.text: Les saisons semblent se dérégler, avec des hivers trop doux et des étés de plus en plus imprévisibles.
weather and seasons.en: The seasons seem to be going haywire, with winters too mild and summers more and more unpredictable.
weather and seasons.pt: As estações parecem estar desreguladas, com invernos amenos demais e verões cada vez mais imprevisíveis.

weather and seasons.text: Dès les premiers rayons de soleil, les Parisiens envahissent les terrasses et les quais de Seine.
weather and seasons.en: As soon as the first rays of sun appear, Parisians flood the café terraces and the banks of the Seine.
weather and seasons.pt: Aos primeiros raios de sol, os parisienses invadem os terraços e as margens do Sena.

weather and seasons.text: Est-ce qu'on maintient la sortie en mer malgré l'avis de tempête, ou est-ce qu'on reste prudents ?
weather and seasons.en: Are we going ahead with the boat trip despite the storm warning, or are we playing it safe?
weather and seasons.pt: Mantemos o passeio de barco apesar do alerta de tempestade, ou vamos ser prudentes?

weather and seasons.text: Il faisait si chaud dans l'appartement que nous avons fini par dormir sur le balcon.
weather and seasons.en: It was so hot in the flat that we ended up sleeping on the balcony.
weather and seasons.pt: Estava tão quente no apartamento que acabamos dormindo na varanda.

weather and seasons.text: Chaque année, j'attends avec impatience le premier jour où l'on peut enfin dîner dehors.
weather and seasons.en: Every year, I eagerly await the first day when we can finally have dinner outside.
weather and seasons.pt: Todo ano, espero ansiosamente o primeiro dia em que finalmente dá para jantar ao ar livre.

hobbies and weekends.text: Depuis que je me suis mis à la poterie, je passe tous mes samedis matin les mains dans l'argile.
hobbies and weekends.en: Since I took up pottery, I spend every Saturday morning with my hands in clay.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Desde que comecei a fazer cerâmica, passo todas as manhãs de sábado com as mãos no barro.

hobbies and weekends.text: Ce week-end, nous comptons faire une randonnée dans le Vercors, à condition que la météo le permette.
hobbies and weekends.en: This weekend we plan to go hiking in the Vercors, provided the weather allows.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Neste fim de semana, pretendemos fazer uma trilha no Vercors, desde que o tempo permita.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je me suis inscrit dans une chorale, bien que je chante faux, de l'avis de toute ma famille.
hobbies and weekends.en: I joined a choir, even though I sing out of tune, according to my whole family.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Entrei para um coral, embora eu cante desafinado, segundo a minha família inteira.

hobbies and weekends.text: Julie lit au moins deux romans par semaine, ce qui force l'admiration de tous ses collègues.
hobbies and weekends.en: Julie reads at least two novels a week, which earns the admiration of all her colleagues.
hobbies and weekends.pt: A Julie lê pelo menos dois romances por semana, o que causa admiração em todos os colegas dela.

hobbies and weekends.text: Ça te tenterait de venir avec nous au festival de jazz de Marciac, l'été prochain ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Would you fancy coming with us to the Marciac jazz festival next summer?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você toparia vir com a gente ao festival de jazz de Marciac no verão que vem?

hobbies and weekends.text: Si j'avais plus de temps libre, j'apprendrais le piano, que j'ai abandonné bêtement à l'adolescence.
hobbies and weekends.en: If I had more free time, I'd learn the piano, which I foolishly gave up as a teenager.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Se eu tivesse mais tempo livre, aprenderia piano, que larguei bobamente na adolescência.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le dimanche, rien ne me plaît davantage que de flâner dans les brocantes à la recherche de vieux disques.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Sundays, nothing pleases me more than wandering around flea markets looking for old records.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No domingo, nada me agrada mais do que passear pelos brechós em busca de discos antigos.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mon mari s'est découvert une passion pour le jardinage, au point d'avoir transformé la pelouse en potager.
hobbies and weekends.en: My husband has discovered a passion for gardening, to the point of turning the lawn into a vegetable patch.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu marido descobriu uma paixão pela jardinagem, a ponto de transformar o gramado numa horta.

hobbies and weekends.text: On a passé le week-end à ne rien faire, et franchement, ça faisait une éternité que ça ne nous était pas arrivé.
hobbies and weekends.en: We spent the weekend doing nothing, and frankly, it had been ages since that had happened to us.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Passamos o fim de semana sem fazer nada, e sinceramente fazia uma eternidade que isso não acontecia.

hobbies and weekends.text: Pierre court trois fois par semaine en vue du marathon de Paris, qu'il espère boucler en moins de quatre heures.
hobbies and weekends.en: Pierre runs three times a week in preparation for the Paris marathon, which he hopes to finish in under four hours.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O Pierre corre três vezes por semana se preparando para a maratona de Paris, que espera completar em menos de quatro horas.

hobbies and weekends.text: La photographie de rue m'a appris à regarder la ville avec des yeux complètement différents.
hobbies and weekends.en: Street photography has taught me to look at the city with completely different eyes.
hobbies and weekends.pt: A fotografia de rua me ensinou a olhar a cidade com olhos completamente diferentes.

hobbies and weekends.text: Tu viens toujours au club de lecture jeudi soir, ou tu as finalement renoncé à finir ce pavé ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Are you still coming to book club on Thursday evening, or have you finally given up on finishing that doorstop of a book?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você ainda vai ao clube do livro na quinta à noite, ou finalmente desistiu de terminar aquele calhamaço?

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous avons pris l'habitude de partir camper un week-end par mois, quelle que soit la saison.
hobbies and weekends.en: We've got into the habit of going camping one weekend a month, whatever the season.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Pegamos o hábito de acampar um fim de semana por mês, seja qual for a estação.

hobbies and weekends.text: Je me suis lancé dans la restauration de meubles anciens, même si mon garage ressemble désormais à un atelier.
hobbies and weekends.en: I've taken up restoring antique furniture, even though my garage now looks like a workshop.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Comecei a restaurar móveis antigos, mesmo que minha garagem agora pareça uma oficina.

hobbies and weekends.text: Il n'y a rien de plus apaisant que de pêcher au bord d'un lac au lever du jour.
hobbies and weekends.en: There's nothing more soothing than fishing by a lake at daybreak.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Não há nada mais relaxante do que pescar à beira de um lago ao amanhecer.

hobbies and weekends.text: Bien qu'elle ait commencé l'escalade il y a à peine un an, Chloé grimpe déjà des voies très difficiles.
hobbies and weekends.en: Although she only started climbing a year ago, Chloé is already climbing very difficult routes.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Embora tenha começado a escalar há apenas um ano, a Chloé já sobe vias muito difíceis.

hobbies and weekends.text: On se fait une soirée jeux de société samedi, tu es partant ou tu as déjà quelque chose de prévu ?
hobbies and weekends.en: We're having a board game night on Saturday, are you in or do you already have plans?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Vamos fazer uma noite de jogos de tabuleiro no sábado, você topa ou já tem algum compromisso?

hobbies and weekends.text: Mes week-ends sont tellement chargés entre le foot des enfants et les courses que je n'arrive jamais à me reposer.
hobbies and weekends.en: My weekends are so busy between the kids' football and the shopping that I never manage to rest.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meus fins de semana são tão cheios entre o futebol das crianças e as compras que nunca consigo descansar.

hobbies and weekends.text: J'ai toujours rêvé d'apprendre à faire de la voile, et je me suis enfin décidé à prendre des cours cet été.
hobbies and weekends.en: I've always dreamed of learning to sail, and I've finally decided to take lessons this summer.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Sempre sonhei em aprender a velejar, e finalmente decidi fazer aulas neste verão.

hobbies and weekends.text: Plutôt que de rester scotchés aux écrans, nous avons emmené les enfants faire une chasse aux champignons.
hobbies and weekends.en: Rather than staying glued to screens, we took the kids mushroom hunting.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Em vez de ficarmos grudados nas telas, levamos as crianças para caçar cogumelos.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le tricot, que je trouvais ringard autrefois, est devenu pour moi une véritable forme de méditation.
hobbies and weekends.en: Knitting, which I used to find old-fashioned, has become a real form of meditation for me.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O tricô, que eu achava cafona antigamente, virou para mim uma verdadeira forma de meditação.

hobbies and weekends.text: Thomas collectionne les timbres depuis l'âge de huit ans et possède aujourd'hui plus de dix mille pièces.
hobbies and weekends.en: Thomas has collected stamps since the age of eight and now owns over ten thousand items.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O Thomas coleciona selos desde os oito anos e hoje tem mais de dez mil peças.

hobbies and weekends.text: Si tu aimes les sensations fortes, le parapente au-dessus du lac d'Annecy est une expérience inoubliable.
hobbies and weekends.en: If you like thrills, paragliding over Lake Annecy is an unforgettable experience.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Se você gosta de emoções fortes, o parapente sobre o lago de Annecy é uma experiência inesquecível.

hobbies and weekends.text: Le dimanche matin, je fais la grasse matinée, puis je prends un long petit-déjeuner en écoutant la radio.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Sunday mornings I have a lie-in, then a long breakfast listening to the radio.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No domingo de manhã, durmo até tarde e depois tomo um café da manhã demorado ouvindo rádio.

hobbies and weekends.text: Depuis qu'on a adopté un chien, nos week-ends se résument à de longues balades en forêt.
hobbies and weekends.en: Since we adopted a dog, our weekends come down to long walks in the forest.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Desde que adotamos um cachorro, nossos fins de semana se resumem a longas caminhadas na floresta.

hobbies and weekends.text: J'ai fini par abandonner la guitare, faute de pouvoir m'entraîner régulièrement avec mes horaires de travail.
hobbies and weekends.en: I ended up giving up the guitar, as I couldn't practise regularly with my work hours.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Acabei largando o violão, por não conseguir praticar regularmente com meus horários de trabalho.

hobbies and weekends.text: Ce qui me plaît dans la cuisine, c'est qu'on peut sans cesse expérimenter de nouvelles saveurs.
hobbies and weekends.en: What I like about cooking is that you can keep experimenting with new flavours.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O que eu gosto na culinária é que dá para experimentar novos sabores o tempo todo.

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous avons fait une escapade improvisée à Honfleur, sans réservation ni programme, et c'était parfait.
hobbies and weekends.en: We took an impromptu getaway to Honfleur, with no booking or plan, and it was perfect.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Fizemos uma escapada improvisada para Honfleur, sem reserva nem programação, e foi perfeito.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mon voisin passe ses week-ends à construire des maquettes de bateaux d'une précision hallucinante.
hobbies and weekends.en: My neighbour spends his weekends building model ships of astonishing precision.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu vizinho passa os fins de semana construindo maquetes de navios de uma precisão impressionante.

hobbies and weekends.text: Ça fait des mois que je me promets de reprendre la natation, mais je trouve toujours une excuse.
hobbies and weekends.en: I've been promising myself for months to get back into swimming, but I always find an excuse.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Faz meses que prometo a mim mesmo voltar a nadar, mas sempre arrumo uma desculpa.

hobbies and weekends.text: Tu ne devineras jamais qui j'ai croisé au cours de salsa samedi dernier !
hobbies and weekends.en: You'll never guess who I ran into at salsa class last Saturday!
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você nunca vai adivinhar quem eu encontrei na aula de salsa no sábado passado!

hobbies and weekends.text: Le bénévolat à la banque alimentaire m'apporte bien plus de satisfaction que n'importe quel loisir.
hobbies and weekends.en: Volunteering at the food bank gives me far more satisfaction than any hobby.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O voluntariado no banco de alimentos me traz muito mais satisfação do que qualquer passatempo.

hobbies and weekends.text: Si le temps le permet, on pourrait louer des kayaks et descendre l'Ardèche dimanche.
hobbies and weekends.en: Weather permitting, we could rent kayaks and go down the Ardèche on Sunday.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Se o tempo permitir, poderíamos alugar caiaques e descer o rio Ardèche no domingo.

hobbies and weekends.text: Ma fille passe des heures à dessiner des mangas, et je dois reconnaître qu'elle a un vrai talent.
hobbies and weekends.en: My daughter spends hours drawing manga, and I must admit she has real talent.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Minha filha passa horas desenhando mangás, e preciso reconhecer que ela tem um talento de verdade.

hobbies and weekends.text: Les échecs, que j'ai découverts pendant le confinement, sont devenus une véritable obsession.
hobbies and weekends.en: Chess, which I discovered during lockdown, has become a real obsession.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O xadrez, que descobri durante o confinamento, virou uma verdadeira obsessão.

hobbies and weekends.text: On était censés aller au cinéma, mais on a fini par refaire le monde jusqu'à deux heures du matin.
hobbies and weekends.en: We were supposed to go to the cinema, but we ended up putting the world to rights until two in the morning.
hobbies and weekends.pt: A gente ia ao cinema, mas acabou conversando sobre a vida até as duas da manhã.

hobbies and weekends.text: Il paraît que la nouvelle exposition au Centre Pompidou vaut vraiment le détour, on y va ensemble ?
hobbies and weekends.en: Apparently the new exhibition at the Centre Pompidou is really worth seeing, shall we go together?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Dizem que a nova exposição no Centre Pompidou vale muito a pena, vamos juntos?

hobbies and weekends.text: Je me ressource en passant mes dimanches à bricoler, loin des notifications et des e-mails.
hobbies and weekends.en: I recharge by spending my Sundays doing DIY, far from notifications and emails.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu recarrego as energias passando os domingos fazendo consertos e trabalhos manuais, longe das notificações e dos e-mails.

hobbies and weekends.text: Nous sommes allés voir une pièce de théâtre si ennuyeuse que la moitié de la salle s'est endormie.
hobbies and weekends.en: We went to see a play so boring that half the audience fell asleep.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Fomos ver uma peça de teatro tão chata que metade da plateia dormiu.

hobbies and weekends.text: Faire du vélo le long de la Loire, de château en château, c'est mon idée du week-end idéal.
hobbies and weekends.en: Cycling along the Loire, from château to château, is my idea of the perfect weekend.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Pedalar ao longo do Loire, de castelo em castelo, é a minha ideia de fim de semana perfeito.

home and daily routine.text: Je me lève tous les jours à six heures, quitte à me coucher tôt, pour profiter du calme de la maison.
home and daily routine.en: I get up at six every day, even if it means going to bed early, to enjoy the peace and quiet of the house.
home and daily routine.pt: Acordo todo dia às seis, mesmo que isso signifique dormir cedo, para aproveitar a calma da casa.

home and daily routine.text: Depuis que nous avons emménagé, nous n'avons pas encore trouvé le temps de déballer tous les cartons.
home and daily routine.en: Since we moved in, we still haven't found the time to unpack all the boxes.
home and daily routine.pt: Desde que nos mudamos, ainda não tivemos tempo de desempacotar todas as caixas.

home and daily routine.text: Chez nous, c'est celui qui cuisine qui est dispensé de vaisselle, c'est une règle sacrée.
home and daily routine.en: At our place, whoever cooks is excused from washing up, it's a sacred rule.
home and daily routine.pt: Lá em casa, quem cozinha não lava a louça, é uma regra sagrada.

home and daily routine.text: La machine à laver a rendu l'âme en plein cycle, et la salle de bains a été inondée.
home and daily routine.en: The washing machine gave up the ghost mid-cycle, and the bathroom was flooded.
home and daily routine.pt: A máquina de lavar pifou no meio do ciclo, e o banheiro ficou inundado.

home and daily routine.text: Il faudrait vraiment qu'on fasse du tri dans le grenier avant de ne plus pouvoir y mettre les pieds.
home and daily routine.en: We really should sort out the attic before we can no longer set foot in it.
home and daily routine.pt: A gente precisava muito dar uma organizada no sótão antes que não dê mais nem para entrar lá.

home and daily routine.text: Le matin, entre le petit-déjeuner des enfants et les embouteillages, je n'ai pas une seconde à moi.
home and daily routine.en: In the morning, between the kids' breakfast and the traffic jams, I don't have a second to myself.
home and daily routine.pt: De manhã, entre o café das crianças e os engarrafamentos, não tenho um segundo para mim.

home and daily routine.text: Si tu sors les poubelles ce soir, je m'occuperai du linge demain matin avant de partir.
home and daily routine.en: If you take the bins out tonight, I'll deal with the laundry tomorrow morning before I leave.
home and daily routine.pt: Se você levar o lixo para fora hoje à noite, eu cuido da roupa amanhã de manhã antes de sair.

home and daily routine.text: Nous avons fait isoler les combles l'an dernier, et la facture de chauffage a baissé de moitié.
home and daily routine.en: We had the loft insulated last year, and the heating bill went down by half.
home and daily routine.pt: Mandamos isolar o sótão no ano passado, e a conta de aquecimento caiu pela metade.

home and daily routine.text: J'ai pris l'habitude de préparer mes repas de la semaine le dimanche soir, ce qui me fait gagner un temps fou.
home and daily routine.en: I've got into the habit of preparing the week's meals on Sunday evening, which saves me loads of time.
home and daily routine.pt: Peguei o hábito de preparar as refeições da semana no domingo à noite, o que me faz economizar muito tempo.

home and daily routine.text: Le robinet de la cuisine fuit depuis des semaines, et le plombier ne peut pas passer avant la fin du mois.
home and daily routine.en: The kitchen tap has been leaking for weeks, and the plumber can't come before the end of the month.
home and daily routine.pt: A torneira da cozinha está pingando há semanas, e o encanador não pode vir antes do fim do mês.

home and daily routine.text: Qui a encore laissé la lumière allumée dans le couloir toute la nuit ?
home and daily routine.en: Who left the hallway light on all night again?
home and daily routine.pt: Quem deixou a luz do corredor acesa a noite toda de novo?

home and daily routine.text: Je ne peux pas commencer ma journée sans un café et un quart d'heure de lecture au calme.
home and daily routine.en: I can't start my day without a coffee and a quarter of an hour of quiet reading.
home and daily routine.pt: Não consigo começar o dia sem um café e quinze minutos de leitura em silêncio.

home and daily routine.text: Faute de place dans notre deux-pièces, le bureau fait aussi office de chambre d'amis.
home and daily routine.en: For lack of space in our two-room flat, the study doubles as a guest room.
home and daily routine.pt: Por falta de espaço no nosso apartamento de dois cômodos, o escritório também serve de quarto de hóspedes.

home and daily routine.text: Mes colocataires et moi avons établi un planning de ménage, mais personne ne le respecte vraiment.
home and daily routine.en: My flatmates and I drew up a cleaning rota, but nobody really sticks to it.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu e meus colegas de apartamento fizemos uma escala de limpeza, mas ninguém cumpre de verdade.

home and daily routine.text: Le soir, une fois les enfants couchés, nous savourons enfin un moment de calme sur le canapé.
home and daily routine.en: In the evening, once the kids are in bed, we finally savour a quiet moment on the sofa.
home and daily routine.pt: À noite, depois que as crianças dormem, finalmente saboreamos um momento de calma no sofá.

home and daily routine.text: Je me suis enfermé dehors ce matin, et j'ai dû attendre deux heures que le serrurier arrive.
home and daily routine.en: I locked myself out this morning and had to wait two hours for the locksmith to arrive.
home and daily routine.pt: Fiquei trancado para fora hoje de manhã e tive que esperar duas horas o chaveiro chegar.

home and daily routine.text: Nous rêvons d'une maison avec jardin, mais avec les prix de l'immobilier, il faudra sans doute patienter.
home and daily routine.en: We dream of a house with a garden, but with property prices, we'll probably have to wait.
home and daily routine.pt: Sonhamos com uma casa com jardim, mas com os preços dos imóveis, provavelmente vamos ter que esperar.

home and daily routine.text: Depuis que je travaille à domicile, j'ai dû m'imposer une routine stricte pour ne pas me laisser déborder.
home and daily routine.en: Since I started working from home, I've had to impose a strict routine on myself so as not to get overwhelmed.
home and daily routine.pt: Desde que comecei a trabalhar em casa, tive que me impor uma rotina rígida para não ficar sobrecarregado.

home and daily routine.text: Tu pourrais passer l'aspirateur dans le salon pendant que je range la cuisine ?
home and daily routine.en: Could you vacuum the living room while I tidy up the kitchen?
home and daily routine.pt: Você poderia passar o aspirador na sala enquanto eu arrumo a cozinha?

home and daily routine.text: Les travaux de rénovation ont pris trois mois de plus que prévu, et le budget a explosé.
home and daily routine.en: The renovation works took three months longer than planned, and the budget went through the roof.
home and daily routine.pt: A reforma levou três meses a mais do que o previsto, e o orçamento estourou.

home and daily routine.text: Je mets toujours mon réveil vingt minutes en avance, histoire de pouvoir traîner un peu au lit.
home and daily routine.en: I always set my alarm twenty minutes early, so I can laze around in bed a bit.
home and daily routine.pt: Sempre coloco o despertador vinte minutos mais cedo, para poder enrolar um pouco na cama.

home and daily routine.text: Avec deux chats et un chien, autant dire que le canapé est perpétuellement couvert de poils.
home and daily routine.en: With two cats and a dog, suffice it to say the sofa is perpetually covered in hair.
home and daily routine.pt: Com dois gatos e um cachorro, nem preciso dizer que o sofá vive coberto de pelos.

home and daily routine.text: Nous avons repeint la chambre en vert sauge, et la pièce paraît désormais deux fois plus lumineuse.
home and daily routine.en: We repainted the bedroom sage green, and the room now looks twice as bright.
home and daily routine.pt: Pintamos o quarto de verde-sálvia, e agora o cômodo parece duas vezes mais iluminado.

home and daily routine.text: Le trajet quotidien en RER me prend presque deux heures, ce qui pèse lourdement sur mon moral.
home and daily routine.en: My daily RER commute takes almost two hours, which weighs heavily on my morale.
home and daily routine.pt: O trajeto diário de trem me toma quase duas horas, o que pesa muito no meu ânimo.

home and daily routine.text: Il suffit que je m'absente deux jours pour que la maison ressemble à un champ de bataille.
home and daily routine.en: I only have to be away for two days for the house to look like a battlefield.
home and daily routine.pt: Basta eu me ausentar dois dias para a casa virar um campo de batalha.

home and daily routine.text: Avant de partir, vérifie bien que le gaz est coupé et que toutes les fenêtres sont fermées.
home and daily routine.en: Before you leave, make sure the gas is off and all the windows are closed.
home and daily routine.pt: Antes de sair, confira se o gás está desligado e todas as janelas estão fechadas.

home and daily routine.text: J'ai fini par installer des étagères dans l'entrée, sans quoi on aurait continué à trébucher sur les chaussures.
home and daily routine.en: I ended up putting shelves in the hallway, otherwise we'd have kept tripping over shoes.
home and daily routine.pt: Acabei instalando prateleiras na entrada, senão continuaríamos tropeçando nos sapatos.

home and daily routine.text: Le chauffage collectif ne se met en marche qu'en octobre, si bien qu'on grelotte tout le mois de septembre.
home and daily routine.en: The building's central heating only comes on in October, so we shiver throughout September.
home and daily routine.pt: O aquecimento central do prédio só é ligado em outubro, de modo que passamos setembro inteiro tremendo de frio.

home and daily routine.text: Chaque soir, avant de me coucher, je prépare mes affaires du lendemain pour gagner du temps au réveil.
home and daily routine.en: Every evening before bed, I get my things ready for the next day to save time when I wake up.
home and daily routine.pt: Toda noite, antes de dormir, separo minhas coisas do dia seguinte para ganhar tempo ao acordar.

home and daily routine.text: Notre appartement a beau être petit, il est baigné de lumière du matin au soir.
home and daily routine.en: Small as our flat is, it's bathed in light from morning till night.
home and daily routine.pt: Por menor que seja, nosso apartamento é banhado de luz de manhã até a noite.

home and daily routine.text: Je déteste repasser, alors j'achète systématiquement des chemises qui ne se froissent pas.
home and daily routine.en: I hate ironing, so I always buy shirts that don't crease.
home and daily routine.pt: Detesto passar roupa, então sempre compro camisas que não amassam.

home and daily routine.text: Qui s'occupe de nourrir le poisson rouge quand nous serons partis en vacances ?
home and daily routine.en: Who's going to feed the goldfish while we're away on holiday?
home and daily routine.pt: Quem vai dar comida para o peixinho dourado enquanto estivermos de férias?

home and daily routine.text: Le propriétaire refuse de changer la vieille chaudière, bien qu'elle tombe en panne tous les hivers.
home and daily routine.en: The landlord refuses to replace the old boiler, even though it breaks down every winter.
home and daily routine.pt: O proprietário se recusa a trocar a caldeira velha, embora ela quebre todo inverno.

home and daily routine.text: Depuis que nous faisons le compost, nos poubelles ont diminué de moitié et le jardin s'en porte mieux.
home and daily routine.en: Since we started composting, our rubbish has halved and the garden is better for it.
home and daily routine.pt: Desde que começamos a fazer compostagem, nosso lixo diminuiu pela metade e o jardim agradece.

home and daily routine.text: Le dimanche soir, c'est rituel, on commande une pizza et on regarde un vieux film en famille.
home and daily routine.en: Sunday evening is a ritual, we order a pizza and watch an old film as a family.
home and daily routine.pt: Domingo à noite é sagrado, pedimos uma pizza e assistimos a um filme antigo em família.

home and daily routine.text: Mes voisins du dessus font tellement de bruit que j'ai fini par acheter des bouchons d'oreille.
home and daily routine.en: My upstairs neighbours make so much noise I ended up buying earplugs.
home and daily routine.pt: Meus vizinhos de cima fazem tanto barulho que acabei comprando protetores de ouvido.

home and daily routine.text: En rentrant du travail, j'ai besoin d'une demi-heure de silence avant de pouvoir parler à qui que ce soit.
home and daily routine.en: When I get home from work, I need half an hour of silence before I can talk to anyone.
home and daily routine.pt: Quando chego do trabalho, preciso de meia hora de silêncio antes de conseguir falar com qualquer pessoa.

home and daily routine.text: On a enfin trouvé un équilibre dans le partage des tâches ménagères, après des années de disputes.
home and daily routine.en: We've finally found a balance in sharing the housework, after years of arguments.
home and daily routine.pt: Finalmente encontramos um equilíbrio na divisão das tarefas domésticas, depois de anos de brigas.

home and daily routine.text: Le lave-vaisselle fait un bruit inquiétant depuis hier, tu crois qu'il faut appeler un réparateur ?
home and daily routine.en: The dishwasher has been making a worrying noise since yesterday, do you think we should call a repairman?
home and daily routine.pt: A lava-louças está fazendo um barulho preocupante desde ontem, você acha que precisa chamar um técnico?

home and daily routine.text: Je m'accorde une sieste de vingt minutes après le déjeuner, et ma productivité s'en ressent nettement.
home and daily routine.en: I allow myself a twenty-minute nap after lunch, and my productivity clearly benefits.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu me permito um cochilo de vinte minutos depois do almoço, e minha produtividade melhora visivelmente.

feelings and opinions.text: Je dois avouer que son discours m'a laissé perplexe, tant il semblait contredire tout ce qu'il défendait auparavant.
feelings and opinions.en: I must admit his speech left me puzzled, as it seemed to contradict everything he'd previously argued.
feelings and opinions.pt: Devo confessar que o discurso dele me deixou perplexo, de tanto que parecia contradizer tudo o que ele defendia antes.

feelings and opinions.text: Il me semble que tu exagères un peu, même si je comprends parfaitement ta frustration.
feelings and opinions.en: I think you're exaggerating a bit, even if I fully understand your frustration.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho que você está exagerando um pouco, mesmo que eu entenda perfeitamente sua frustração.

feelings and opinions.text: Ce qui me met hors de moi, c'est qu'on ne m'ait même pas consulté avant de prendre cette décision.
feelings and opinions.en: What drives me mad is that I wasn't even consulted before the decision was made.
feelings and opinions.pt: O que me tira do sério é que nem me consultaram antes de tomar essa decisão.

feelings and opinions.text: J'ai le cœur serré chaque fois que je repense à notre dernière conversation avant son départ.
feelings and opinions.en: My heart sinks every time I think back to our last conversation before he left.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fico com o coração apertado toda vez que penso na nossa última conversa antes da partida dele.

feelings and opinions.text: À mon sens, ce film est largement surestimé, même si la photographie est indéniablement superbe.
feelings and opinions.en: In my view, this film is greatly overrated, even if the cinematography is undeniably superb.
feelings and opinions.pt: Na minha opinião, esse filme é muito superestimado, embora a fotografia seja inegavelmente linda.

feelings and opinions.text: Je ne m'attendais pas à être aussi ému en revoyant la maison où j'ai grandi.
feelings and opinions.en: I didn't expect to be so moved seeing the house where I grew up again.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu não esperava ficar tão emocionado ao rever a casa onde cresci.

feelings and opinions.text: Franchement, je trouve inadmissible qu'on traite les clients de cette manière, quelle que soit la situation.
feelings and opinions.en: Frankly, I find it unacceptable that customers are treated like that, whatever the situation.
feelings and opinions.pt: Sinceramente, acho inadmissível tratar os clientes dessa maneira, seja qual for a situação.

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis partagé entre l'envie de tout plaquer et la peur de regretter ma décision.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm torn between wanting to drop everything and fear of regretting my decision.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou dividido entre a vontade de largar tudo e o medo de me arrepender da decisão.

feelings and opinions.text: Bien que je ne partage pas du tout ton point de vue, je respecte la façon dont tu le défends.
feelings and opinions.en: Although I don't share your point of view at all, I respect the way you defend it.
feelings and opinions.pt: Embora eu não compartilhe nem um pouco do seu ponto de vista, respeito a forma como você o defende.

feelings and opinions.text: Ça me fait chaud au cœur de voir à quel point les gens se sont mobilisés pour aider la famille.
feelings and opinions.en: It warms my heart to see how much people have rallied to help the family.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fico com o coração quentinho ao ver o quanto as pessoas se mobilizaram para ajudar a família.

feelings and opinions.text: J'en ai ras le bol de ces réunions qui ne débouchent jamais sur rien de concret.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm fed up with these meetings that never lead to anything concrete.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou de saco cheio dessas reuniões que nunca dão em nada concreto.

feelings and opinions.text: Tu ne trouves pas qu'elle a été un peu dure avec lui, compte tenu des circonstances ?
feelings and opinions.en: Don't you think she was a bit hard on him, given the circumstances?
feelings and opinions.pt: Você não acha que ela foi meio dura com ele, considerando as circunstâncias?

feelings and opinions.text: Avec le recul, je me rends compte que j'ai eu tort de m'emporter pour une broutille pareille.
feelings and opinions.en: Looking back, I realise I was wrong to lose my temper over such a trifle.
feelings and opinions.pt: Olhando para trás, percebo que errei em me exaltar por uma bobagem dessas.

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis aux anges depuis que j'ai appris que mon roman allait enfin être publié.
feelings and opinions.en: I've been over the moon since I found out my novel was finally going to be published.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou nas nuvens desde que soube que meu romance finalmente vai ser publicado.

feelings and opinions.text: On a beau dire que l'argent ne fait pas le bonheur, il y contribue quand même largement.
feelings and opinions.en: People may say money can't buy happiness, but it still contributes a great deal.
feelings and opinions.pt: Podem dizer que dinheiro não traz felicidade, mas ele contribui bastante.

feelings and opinions.text: Ce qui m'inquiète le plus, ce n'est pas l'échec en soi, mais la réaction de mes parents.
feelings and opinions.en: What worries me most isn't the failure itself, but my parents' reaction.
feelings and opinions.pt: O que mais me preocupa não é o fracasso em si, mas a reação dos meus pais.

feelings and opinions.text: J'avoue avoir eu un pincement au cœur en voyant ma fille partir vivre à l'autre bout du monde.
feelings and opinions.en: I admit I felt a pang seeing my daughter go to live on the other side of the world.
feelings and opinions.pt: Confesso que senti um aperto no coração ao ver minha filha ir morar do outro lado do mundo.

feelings and opinions.text: Il est hors de question que je m'excuse, puisque c'est lui qui a commencé à m'insulter.
feelings and opinions.en: There's no way I'm apologising, since he's the one who started insulting me.
feelings and opinions.pt: Está fora de questão eu pedir desculpas, já que foi ele que começou a me xingar.

feelings and opinions.text: Je me demande parfois si nous avons fait le bon choix en quittant Paris pour la campagne.
feelings and opinions.en: I sometimes wonder whether we made the right choice leaving Paris for the countryside.
feelings and opinions.pt: Às vezes me pergunto se fizemos a escolha certa ao deixar Paris pelo interior.

feelings and opinions.text: Sa remarque, qui se voulait drôle, m'a profondément blessée, et je ne le lui ai jamais dit.
feelings and opinions.en: His remark, meant to be funny, hurt me deeply, and I never told him.
feelings and opinions.pt: O comentário dele, que era para ser engraçado, me magoou profundamente, e eu nunca disse isso a ele.

feelings and opinions.text: Je n'en reviens toujours pas qu'il ait osé me mentir aussi effrontément devant tout le monde.
feelings and opinions.en: I still can't believe he dared to lie to me so brazenly in front of everyone.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ainda não acredito que ele teve a cara de pau de mentir para mim tão descaradamente na frente de todo mundo.

feelings and opinions.text: Selon moi, les réseaux sociaux font davantage de mal que de bien, surtout chez les adolescents.
feelings and opinions.en: In my opinion, social media does more harm than good, especially among teenagers.
feelings and opinions.pt: Para mim, as redes sociais fazem mais mal do que bem, principalmente entre os adolescentes.

feelings and opinions.text: J'ai beau essayer de relativiser, cette histoire me reste en travers de la gorge.
feelings and opinions.en: Try as I might to put it into perspective, this business still sticks in my throat.
feelings and opinions.pt: Por mais que eu tente relativizar, essa história continua entalada na minha garganta.

feelings and opinions.text: Quelle joie de vous revoir après toutes ces années, vous n'avez pas changé d'un pouce !
feelings and opinions.en: What a joy to see you again after all these years, you haven't changed a bit!
feelings and opinions.pt: Que alegria rever vocês depois de todos esses anos, vocês não mudaram nada!

feelings and opinions.text: Je comprends ta déception, mais je reste persuadé que c'est un mal pour un bien.
feelings and opinions.en: I understand your disappointment, but I'm still convinced it's a blessing in disguise.
feelings and opinions.pt: Entendo sua decepção, mas continuo convencido de que há males que vêm para o bem.

feelings and opinions.text: Il me paraît évident que cette réforme pénalisera d'abord les plus modestes, quoi qu'en dise le gouvernement.
feelings and opinions.en: It seems obvious to me that this reform will hit the poorest first, whatever the government says.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me parece evidente que essa reforma vai prejudicar primeiro os mais pobres, diga o governo o que disser.

feelings and opinions.text: Depuis quelque temps, j'éprouve une lassitude que je n'arrive pas vraiment à m'expliquer.
feelings and opinions.en: For some time now, I've felt a weariness I can't really explain.
feelings and opinions.pt: Há algum tempo, sinto um cansaço que não consigo explicar direito.

feelings and opinions.text: Ne le prends pas mal, mais je pense que tu te fais des idées à son sujet.
feelings and opinions.en: Don't take it the wrong way, but I think you're imagining things about him.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não leve a mal, mas acho que você está imaginando coisas sobre ele.

feelings and opinions.text: J'étais mort de trac avant de monter sur scène, mais tout s'est finalement très bien passé.
feelings and opinions.en: I was scared stiff before going on stage, but in the end everything went really well.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu estava morrendo de nervoso antes de subir no palco, mas no fim deu tudo muito certo.

feelings and opinions.text: Je suis plutôt d'accord avec toi sur le fond, mais pas du tout sur la forme.
feelings and opinions.en: I mostly agree with you on the substance, but not at all on the form.
feelings and opinions.pt: Concordo com você no conteúdo, mas nem um pouco na forma.

feelings and opinions.text: Ça me fend le cœur de voir ce vieux cinéma de quartier fermer définitivement ses portes.
feelings and opinions.en: It breaks my heart to see this old neighbourhood cinema close its doors for good.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me parte o coração ver esse velho cinema de bairro fechar as portas de vez.

feelings and opinions.text: Je trouve plutôt rafraîchissant qu'un homme politique admette enfin publiquement s'être trompé sur toute la ligne.
feelings and opinions.en: I find it rather refreshing that a politician finally admits publicly that he was wrong all along.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho bem revigorante que um político finalmente admita publicamente que errou em tudo.

feelings and opinions.text: Tu as entièrement raison, et je m'en veux de ne pas t'avoir écouté plus tôt.
feelings and opinions.en: You're completely right, and I'm annoyed with myself for not listening to you sooner.
feelings and opinions.pt: Você tem toda a razão, e me culpo por não ter te ouvido antes.

feelings and opinions.text: Ce genre de comportement me hérisse le poil, surtout de la part de quelqu'un d'aussi instruit.
feelings and opinions.en: That kind of behaviour gets my back up, especially from someone so educated.
feelings and opinions.pt: Esse tipo de comportamento me deixa irritado, ainda mais vindo de alguém tão instruído.

feelings and opinions.text: Elle a accueilli la nouvelle avec un calme déconcertant, comme si elle s'y attendait depuis longtemps.
feelings and opinions.en: She took the news with disconcerting calm, as if she'd been expecting it for a long time.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ela recebeu a notícia com uma calma desconcertante, como se já esperasse por isso havia muito tempo.

feelings and opinions.text: Je ne saurais dire si je suis soulagé ou déçu que le projet ait été abandonné.
feelings and opinions.en: I couldn't say whether I'm relieved or disappointed that the project was dropped.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não sei dizer se estou aliviado ou decepcionado com o abandono do projeto.

feelings and opinions.text: Pour être tout à fait honnête, j'ai trouvé le spectacle interminable et un brin prétentieux.
feelings and opinions.en: To be completely honest, I found the show endless and a touch pretentious.
feelings and opinions.pt: Para ser bem sincero, achei o espetáculo interminável e um tanto pretensioso.

feelings and opinions.text: C'est fou comme une simple lettre peut vous redonner le moral après une semaine épouvantable.
feelings and opinions.en: It's amazing how a simple letter can lift your spirits after a terrible week.
feelings and opinions.pt: É incrível como uma simples carta pode levantar o ânimo depois de uma semana horrível.

feelings and opinions.text: Je ne suis pas certain que ce soit une bonne idée, mais je te fais confiance.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm not sure it's a good idea, but I trust you.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não tenho certeza de que seja uma boa ideia, mas confio em você.

feelings and opinions.text: Il m'a fallu des années pour accepter que je ne pourrais jamais plaire à tout le monde.
feelings and opinions.en: It took me years to accept that I could never please everyone.
feelings and opinions.pt: Levei anos para aceitar que eu nunca conseguiria agradar a todo mundo.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Bonjour madame Martin, vous avez passé de bonnes vacances, malgré la chaleur écrasante de cet été ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Hello Mrs Martin, did you have a good holiday, despite the crushing heat this summer?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Bom dia, dona Martin, a senhora teve boas férias, apesar do calor sufocante deste verão?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez entendu parler des travaux de ravalement qui doivent commencer le mois prochain dans l'immeuble ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you heard about the facade renovation work that's due to start on the building next month?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você ficou sabendo da reforma da fachada que deve começar no mês que vem no prédio?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre jardin est toujours aussi magnifique, je me demande comment vous trouvez le temps de l'entretenir.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your garden is as magnificent as ever, I wonder how you find the time to look after it.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seu jardim continua lindo como sempre, me pergunto como você arruma tempo para cuidar dele.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je ne voudrais pas vous déranger, mais vous auriez par hasard un tournevis à me prêter ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: I don't want to bother you, but would you happen to have a screwdriver you could lend me?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Não queria incomodar, mas por acaso você teria uma chave de fenda para me emprestar?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Il paraît que la boulangerie du coin va fermer, ce serait vraiment dommage pour le quartier.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Apparently the corner bakery is going to close, it would be a real shame for the neighbourhood.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Dizem que a padaria da esquina vai fechar, seria uma pena para o bairro.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ça fait plaisir de voir enfin un peu de soleil, on commençait à désespérer, vous ne trouvez pas ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: It's nice to finally see a bit of sun, we were starting to despair, don't you think?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Que bom finalmente ver um pouco de sol, a gente já estava perdendo as esperanças, não acha?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Si jamais vous partez en week-end, n'hésitez pas à me laisser vos clés pour arroser les plantes.
small talk with a neighbour.en: If you ever go away for the weekend, don't hesitate to leave me your keys so I can water the plants.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Se por acaso você viajar no fim de semana, não hesite em me deixar as chaves para eu regar as plantas.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre fils a drôlement grandi, la dernière fois que je l'ai vu, il m'arrivait à peine à la taille !
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your son has really grown, last time I saw him he barely came up to my waist!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seu filho cresceu muito, da última vez que o vi ele mal chegava na minha cintura!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je crois que le colis que vous attendiez a été déposé chez moi par erreur ce matin.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I think the parcel you were expecting was dropped off at my place by mistake this morning.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Acho que a encomenda que você estava esperando foi deixada na minha casa por engano hoje de manhã.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous savez si la réunion des copropriétaires a bien lieu jeudi, ou a-t-elle été reportée ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you know if the residents' meeting is still on for Thursday, or has it been postponed?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você sabe se a reunião de condomínio vai mesmo acontecer na quinta, ou foi adiada?

small talk with a neighbour.text: On a fêté l'anniversaire de ma femme samedi soir, j'espère que la musique ne vous a pas trop gênés.
small talk with a neighbour.en: We celebrated my wife's birthday on Saturday night, I hope the music didn't bother you too much.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Comemoramos o aniversário da minha esposa no sábado à noite, espero que a música não tenha incomodado muito vocês.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Quelle chance vous avez d'être à la retraite, vous pouvez enfin profiter de vos petits-enfants !
small talk with a neighbour.en: How lucky you are to be retired, you can finally enjoy your grandchildren!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Que sorte a sua de estar aposentado, agora pode finalmente aproveitar os netos!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Le nouveau locataire du troisième a l'air sympathique, même s'il ne dit jamais bonjour dans l'escalier.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The new tenant on the third floor seems nice, even if he never says hello on the stairs.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O novo inquilino do terceiro andar parece simpático, mesmo que nunca dê bom-dia na escada.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre chat s'est encore aventuré sur mon balcon cette nuit, il a l'air de s'y plaire beaucoup.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your cat ventured onto my balcony again last night, he seems to like it there a lot.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seu gato se aventurou de novo na minha varanda esta noite, parece que ele gosta muito de lá.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous ne trouvez pas que le quartier a beaucoup changé depuis l'ouverture de toutes ces boutiques branchées ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Don't you think the neighbourhood has changed a lot since all those trendy shops opened?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você não acha que o bairro mudou muito desde que abriram todas essas lojas descoladas?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je vous ai apporté quelques tomates du potager, j'en ai tellement que je ne sais plus quoi en faire.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I've brought you a few tomatoes from the vegetable garden, I have so many I don't know what to do with them.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Trouxe uns tomates da horta para você, tenho tantos que não sei mais o que fazer com eles.

small talk with a neighbour.text: L'ascenseur est encore en panne, ça devient franchement pénible pour ceux qui habitent au dernier étage.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The lift's broken down again, it's getting really tiresome for those who live on the top floor.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O elevador quebrou de novo, está ficando bem chato para quem mora no último andar.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez vu qu'ils allaient enfin installer des pistes cyclables dans notre rue ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Did you see they're finally going to put cycle lanes in our street?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você viu que finalmente vão fazer ciclovias na nossa rua?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Bonsoir monsieur Dubois, toujours fidèle à votre promenade du soir avec Max, à ce que je vois !
small talk with a neighbour.en: Good evening Mr Dubois, still faithful to your evening walk with Max, I see!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Boa noite, seu Dubois, sempre fiel ao passeio da noite com o Max, pelo que vejo!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Nous allons organiser une fête des voisins dans la cour en juin, ça vous dirait de vous joindre à nous ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: We're organising a neighbours' party in the courtyard in June, would you like to join us?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vamos organizar uma festa dos vizinhos no pátio em junho, você gostaria de participar?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Avec tout ce vent, j'ai bien peur que vos pots de fleurs ne soient tombés du rebord.
small talk with a neighbour.en: With all this wind, I'm afraid your flowerpots have fallen off the ledge.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Com todo esse vento, receio que seus vasos de flores tenham caído do parapeito.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Depuis que vous avez taillé la haie, on profite enfin du soleil l'après-midi, merci encore.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Since you trimmed the hedge, we finally get the sun in the afternoon, thanks again.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Desde que você podou a cerca viva, finalmente temos sol à tarde, obrigado de novo.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous êtes au courant de ce qui s'est passé hier soir, il y avait des pompiers partout dans la rue ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you know what happened last night, there were firefighters all over the street?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você está sabendo do que aconteceu ontem à noite, tinha bombeiro pela rua toda?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je vous trouve bien en forme, votre cure en Auvergne vous a fait le plus grand bien, on dirait.
small talk with a neighbour.en: You look in great shape, your spa stay in Auvergne seems to have done you a world of good.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você parece ótimo, parece que a temporada de tratamento em Auvergne te fez muito bem.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Excusez-moi pour le bruit des perceuses ces derniers jours, les travaux devraient se terminer vendredi.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Sorry about the drilling noise these last few days, the work should be finished on Friday.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Desculpe pelo barulho das furadeiras nos últimos dias, a obra deve terminar na sexta.

small talk with a neighbour.text: J'ai appris que votre fille avait décroché son bac avec mention, toutes mes félicitations à elle !
small talk with a neighbour.en: I heard your daughter passed her baccalaureate with honours, my congratulations to her!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Fiquei sabendo que sua filha passou no bac com menção honrosa, meus parabéns para ela!

small talk with a neighbour.text: On dirait que les cambriolages se multiplient dans le secteur, vous avez pensé à installer une alarme ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: It seems burglaries are on the rise in the area, have you thought about installing an alarm?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Parece que os assaltos a residências estão aumentando na região, você já pensou em instalar um alarme?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ça fait combien de temps que vous habitez ici, déjà, une vingtaine d'années ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: How long have you lived here again, about twenty years?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Faz quanto tempo mesmo que você mora aqui, uns vinte anos?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Si vous avez besoin d'un coup de main pour le déménagement, n'hésitez surtout pas à frapper chez nous.
small talk with a neighbour.en: If you need a hand with the move, please don't hesitate to knock on our door.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Se precisar de uma mão na mudança, não hesite de jeito nenhum em bater na nossa porta.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Le marché du dimanche est de plus en plus animé, vous y allez toujours de bonne heure ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: The Sunday market is getting livelier and livelier, do you still go early?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: A feira de domingo está cada vez mais movimentada, você ainda vai bem cedinho?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vos rosiers sont en fleur bien avant les miens, vous avez un secret à partager ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your roses are in bloom well before mine, do you have a secret to share?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Suas roseiras florescem bem antes das minhas, você tem algum segredo para compartilhar?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je viens de croiser le facteur, il m'a dit que le courrier serait distribué plus tard cette semaine.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I just ran into the postman, he told me the post would be delivered later this week.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Acabei de encontrar o carteiro, ele me disse que a correspondência vai ser entregue mais tarde esta semana.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous ne seriez pas un peu fâché avec le syndic, vu le ton de votre affiche dans le hall ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: You wouldn't be a bit cross with the building management, judging by the tone of your notice in the hall?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você não estaria meio irritado com a administradora, a julgar pelo tom do seu aviso no saguão?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Quel plaisir de vous croiser, ça faisait des semaines que je ne vous avais pas vue dans le quartier !
small talk with a neighbour.en: What a pleasure to bump into you, I hadn't seen you in the neighbourhood for weeks!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Que prazer encontrar você, fazia semanas que eu não te via no bairro!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Mon mari et moi partons trois semaines au Portugal, pourriez-vous jeter un œil à la maison de temps en temps ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: My husband and I are going to Portugal for three weeks, could you keep an eye on the house from time to time?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Meu marido e eu vamos passar três semanas em Portugal, você poderia dar uma olhada na casa de vez em quando?

small talk with a neighbour.text: On a beau dire, les nouveaux lampadaires éclairent quand même beaucoup mieux la rue la nuit.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Say what you like, the new streetlights light the street much better at night.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Digam o que quiserem, os novos postes iluminam bem melhor a rua à noite.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez des nouvelles de madame Leroy, je ne l'ai pas vue depuis son hospitalisation ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you had any news of Mrs Leroy, I haven't seen her since she went into hospital?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você tem notícias da dona Leroy, que eu não vejo desde a internação dela?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Dites, ça ne vous embête pas si je gare ma voiture devant chez vous ce soir, juste pour une heure ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Say, would you mind if I parked my car in front of your place tonight, just for an hour?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Diga uma coisa, você se importa se eu estacionar o carro na frente da sua casa hoje à noite, só por uma hora?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Les enfants du deuxième jouent si bien du violon qu'on croirait entendre un concert dans la cage d'escalier.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The kids on the second floor play the violin so well you'd think there was a concert in the stairwell.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: As crianças do segundo andar tocam violino tão bem que parece um concerto na escadaria.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Bon, je ne vous retiens pas plus longtemps, passez une excellente soirée et à bientôt !
small talk with a neighbour.en: Well, I won't keep you any longer, have a lovely evening and see you soon!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Bom, não vou te prender mais, tenha uma ótima noite e até logo!

phone calls and appointments.text: Bonjour, je vous appelle pour prendre rendez-vous avec le docteur Moreau, de préférence en fin de semaine.
phone calls and appointments.en: Hello, I'm calling to make an appointment with Dr Moreau, preferably at the end of the week.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Bom dia, estou ligando para marcar uma consulta com o doutor Moreau, de preferência no fim da semana.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je suis désolé, la ligne est très mauvaise, pourriez-vous répéter votre numéro plus lentement ?
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm sorry, the line is very bad, could you repeat your number more slowly?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, a ligação está muito ruim, você poderia repetir seu número mais devagar?

phone calls and appointments.text: Ne quittez pas, je vais voir si madame Lefèvre est disponible pour prendre votre appel.
phone calls and appointments.en: Hold the line, I'll see if Mrs Lefèvre is available to take your call.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Não desligue, vou ver se a senhora Lefèvre está disponível para atender sua ligação.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je me vois malheureusement contraint d'annuler notre rendez-vous de jeudi en raison d'un imprévu.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm unfortunately forced to cancel our Thursday appointment due to an unforeseen event.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Infelizmente, sou obrigado a cancelar nosso compromisso de quinta por causa de um imprevisto.

phone calls and appointments.text: Ça fait vingt minutes que je patiente avec cette musique d'attente insupportable, c'est un comble !
phone calls and appointments.en: I've been waiting twenty minutes with this unbearable hold music, it's the last straw!
phone calls and appointments.pt: Faz vinte minutos que estou esperando com essa música de espera insuportável, é o cúmulo!

phone calls and appointments.text: Pourriez-vous lui demander de me rappeler dès qu'il sera sorti de réunion, c'est assez urgent ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you ask him to call me back as soon as he's out of his meeting, it's quite urgent?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você poderia pedir para ele me retornar assim que sair da reunião, porque é bem urgente?

phone calls and appointments.text: Si ce créneau ne vous convient pas, je peux vous proposer mardi à quatorze heures trente.
phone calls and appointments.en: If that slot doesn't suit you, I can offer you Tuesday at 2:30 p.m.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Se esse horário não for bom para você, posso oferecer terça às catorze e trinta.

phone calls and appointments.text: J'ai essayé de vous joindre à plusieurs reprises, mais je tombais systématiquement sur votre messagerie.
phone calls and appointments.en: I tried to reach you several times, but I kept getting your voicemail.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Tentei falar com você várias vezes, mas sempre caía na caixa postal.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vous rappelle d'ici une heure, le temps de vérifier les disponibilités de mon associé.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll call you back within the hour, once I've checked my partner's availability.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Te ligo de volta daqui a uma hora, depois de verificar a disponibilidade do meu sócio.

phone calls and appointments.text: C'est de la part de qui, s'il vous plaît, afin que je puisse annoncer votre appel ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Who's calling, please, so I can announce your call?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Quem gostaria de falar, por favor, para eu poder anunciar sua ligação?

phone calls and appointments.text: Mon rendez-vous chez le coiffeur a été décalé à la dernière minute, ce qui chamboule tout mon après-midi.
phone calls and appointments.en: My hairdresser's appointment was moved at the last minute, which turns my whole afternoon upside down.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Meu horário no cabeleireiro foi remarcado na última hora, o que bagunça minha tarde inteira.

phone calls and appointments.text: Vous êtes bien au cabinet du docteur Benoît, nous sommes actuellement fermés, merci de rappeler à partir de neuf heures.
phone calls and appointments.en: You've reached Dr Benoît's surgery, we're currently closed, please call back from nine o'clock.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você ligou para o consultório do doutor Benoît, no momento estamos fechados, por favor ligue novamente a partir das nove horas.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je crois que vous avez fait un faux numéro, il n'y a aucune Isabelle à ce numéro.
phone calls and appointments.en: I think you've dialled the wrong number, there's no Isabelle at this number.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Acho que você ligou para o número errado, não tem nenhuma Isabelle neste número.

phone calls and appointments.text: Est-il possible de reporter l'entretien à la semaine prochaine, car je serai en déplacement jusqu'à vendredi ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Is it possible to postpone the interview to next week, as I'll be travelling until Friday?
