phone calls and appointments.pt: É possível adiar a entrevista para a semana que vem, já que vou estar viajando até sexta?

phone calls and appointments.text: Ma batterie est presque à plat, alors je te rappelle dès que je suis rentré à la maison.
phone calls and appointments.en: My battery's almost dead, so I'll call you back as soon as I'm home.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Minha bateria está quase acabando, então te ligo assim que chegar em casa.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le conseiller m'a promis de me rappeler dans la journée, mais je n'ai toujours pas eu de nouvelles.
phone calls and appointments.en: The adviser promised to call me back during the day, but I still haven't heard anything.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O atendente prometeu me retornar no mesmo dia, mas até agora não tive notícias.

phone calls and appointments.text: Pour confirmer votre rendez-vous, tapez un, pour le modifier ou l'annuler, tapez deux.
phone calls and appointments.en: To confirm your appointment, press one, to change or cancel it, press two.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Para confirmar sua consulta, digite um, para alterar ou cancelar, digite dois.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vous appelle au sujet de l'annonce pour l'appartement, est-il toujours disponible à la location ?
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm calling about the ad for the flat, is it still available to rent?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou ligando por causa do anúncio do apartamento, ele ainda está disponível para aluguel?

phone calls and appointments.text: Nous avons convenu de nous retrouver devant la mairie à dix heures, mais elle n'est toujours pas arrivée.
phone calls and appointments.en: We agreed to meet outside the town hall at ten, but she still hasn't arrived.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Combinamos de nos encontrar na frente da prefeitura às dez, mas ela ainda não chegou.

phone calls and appointments.text: Pardonnez-moi de vous appeler si tard, mais je voulais m'assurer que vous aviez bien reçu le dossier.
phone calls and appointments.en: Forgive me for calling so late, but I wanted to make sure you'd received the file.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Me desculpe por ligar tão tarde, mas queria ter certeza de que você recebeu a documentação.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je n'ai pas bien saisi votre nom, auriez-vous l'amabilité de me l'épeler ?
phone calls and appointments.en: I didn't quite catch your name, would you be kind enough to spell it for me?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Não entendi bem seu nome, você teria a gentileza de soletrá-lo para mim?

phone calls and appointments.text: Il m'a raccroché au nez avant même que j'aie pu lui expliquer la situation.
phone calls and appointments.en: He hung up on me before I'd even been able to explain the situation.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ele desligou na minha cara antes mesmo que eu pudesse explicar a situação.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le premier rendez-vous disponible chez l'ophtalmologue est dans quatre mois, à moins d'un désistement.
phone calls and appointments.en: The first available appointment with the ophthalmologist is in four months, unless someone cancels.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A primeira consulta disponível com o oftalmologista é daqui a quatro meses, a menos que alguém desista.

phone calls and appointments.text: Merci de m'envoyer une confirmation par SMS, sans quoi je risque fort d'oublier la date.
phone calls and appointments.en: Please send me a confirmation by text, otherwise I'm very likely to forget the date.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Por favor, me mande uma confirmação por SMS, senão é bem provável que eu esqueça a data.

phone calls and appointments.text: Désolé, je t'entends très mal, je suis dans le métro, je te rappelle en sortant.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, I can barely hear you, I'm on the metro, I'll call you back when I get out.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpa, estou te ouvindo muito mal, estou no metrô, te ligo quando sair.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je souhaiterais parler à quelqu'un du service client au sujet d'une facture qui me semble erronée.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'd like to speak to someone in customer service about an invoice that seems to be wrong.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Gostaria de falar com alguém do atendimento ao cliente sobre uma fatura que me parece errada.

phone calls and appointments.text: Comme convenu au téléphone, je vous attendrai à l'accueil à quinze heures précises.
phone calls and appointments.en: As agreed on the phone, I'll wait for you at reception at three o'clock sharp.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Conforme combinado por telefone, vou te esperar na recepção às quinze horas em ponto.

phone calls and appointments.text: Votre correspondant n'est pas joignable pour le moment, veuillez laisser un message après le bip sonore.
phone calls and appointments.en: The person you're calling is not available at the moment, please leave a message after the tone.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A pessoa para quem você ligou não está disponível no momento, por favor deixe uma mensagem após o sinal.

phone calls and appointments.text: Ça t'ennuierait qu'on décale notre déjeuner à demain, j'ai une urgence au bureau ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Would you mind if we moved our lunch to tomorrow, I've got an emergency at the office?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você se importaria se a gente passasse nosso almoço para amanhã, porque surgiu uma emergência no escritório?

phone calls and appointments.text: J'ai noté le rendez-vous dans mon agenda, mais pourriez-vous me rappeler l'adresse exacte du cabinet ?
phone calls and appointments.en: I've put the appointment in my diary, but could you remind me of the exact address of the practice?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Anotei a consulta na agenda, mas você poderia me lembrar o endereço exato do consultório?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je regrette, mais monsieur Garnier est en congé jusqu'au vingt, puis-je vous orienter vers un de ses collègues ?
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm sorry, but Mr Garnier is on leave until the 20th, may I direct you to one of his colleagues?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Sinto muito, mas o senhor Garnier está de folga até o dia vinte, posso encaminhar você para um dos colegas dele?

phone calls and appointments.text: On s'est appelés pendant deux heures hier soir, comme au bon vieux temps de nos études.
phone calls and appointments.en: We were on the phone for two hours last night, like in the good old days when we were students.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ficamos duas horas no telefone ontem à noite, como nos bons tempos da faculdade.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je confirme ma présence au rendez-vous de lundi, mais je risque d'avoir une dizaine de minutes de retard.
phone calls and appointments.en: I confirm I'll be at Monday's appointment, but I may be about ten minutes late.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Confirmo minha presença no compromisso de segunda, mas talvez me atrase uns dez minutos.

phone calls and appointments.text: Excusez-moi, je crois que nous avons été coupés, vous disiez que le devis serait prêt mercredi ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Excuse me, I think we were cut off, you were saying the quote would be ready on Wednesday?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, acho que a ligação caiu, você estava dizendo que o orçamento fica pronto na quarta?

phone calls and appointments.text: Si personne ne décroche au standard, essayez directement le numéro de son portable, que je vous envoie par mail.
phone calls and appointments.en: If no one answers at the switchboard, try his mobile number directly, which I'll email you.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Se ninguém atender na central, tente direto o celular dele, que vou te mandar por e-mail.

phone calls and appointments.text: Elle a horreur du téléphone, si bien qu'elle préfère toujours régler ses affaires par écrit.
phone calls and appointments.en: She hates the phone, so she always prefers to deal with things in writing.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ela detesta telefone, de modo que sempre prefere resolver as coisas por escrito.

phone calls and appointments.text: Puis-je vous joindre à ce numéro en cas de changement, ou préférez-vous être contacté par e-mail ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Can I reach you at this number if there's any change, or would you rather be contacted by email?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Posso falar com você neste número em caso de mudança, ou prefere ser contatado por e-mail?

phone calls and appointments.text: J'ai complètement oublié mon rendez-vous chez le dentiste, et ils vont sans doute me le facturer quand même.
phone calls and appointments.en: I completely forgot my dentist appointment, and they'll probably charge me for it anyway.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Esqueci completamente a consulta no dentista, e eles provavelmente vão me cobrar mesmo assim.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je vous passe le service technique, mais je vous préviens, l'attente risque d'être un peu longue.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll put you through to technical support, but I warn you, the wait may be a bit long.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou transferir você para o suporte técnico, mas já aviso que a espera pode ser um pouco longa.

phone calls and appointments.text: Dès que j'aurai reçu les résultats, je vous appellerai pour fixer un nouveau rendez-vous.
phone calls and appointments.en: As soon as I've received the results, I'll call you to set a new appointment.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Assim que eu receber os resultados, vou te ligar para marcar uma nova consulta.
